jobs.title: AI Application Engineer (AI FDE)
jobs.description: **Apply at https://typify.dev/jobs/view/188** You’ll build the AI that powers Raya’s companion — turning LLMs and agents into a warm, reliable, safe product experience. This is a hands\-on, ship\-fast, close\-to\-the\-user role: you’ll build AI features, watch how real moms use them, and iterate relentlessly — while also pitching in on regular full\-stack work across our codebase. What you’ll do ● Build LLM\-powered features and agents that make our companion genuinely helpful (prompting, RAG, tool\-use, orchestration) ● Design guardrails and escalation so the product stays safe, holds the non\-medical line, and hands off to humans when needed ● Build evals that measure conversation quality, tone, and safety — not just correctness ● Ship AI features end to end in our Angular / NestJS / Postgres stack, from the model layer to the user\-facing experience ● Iterate quickly on real usage; own AI features from prototype to production ● Handle sensitive health data responsibly (HIPAA\-aware) What we’re looking for ● Required of every role — our core stack: hands\-on experience with Angular, NestJS, and Postgres (or the proven ability to ramp into them quickly). Whatever your specialty, you’ll do regular full\-stack work in this stack, not only your focus area. ● Hands\-on experience building LLM applications (agents, RAG, prompt/context engineering, APIs) ● Ability to ship AI features end to end and contribute to general full\-stack work ● A product mindset and bias to ship — you care how real users experience the AI ● Instinct for AI safety, reliability, and evaluation ● Bonus: conversational/voice AI, fine\-tuning and evals, healthcare or safety\-critical AI, MCP Please note that while Raya Health does not offer relocation assistance we (Typify) are happy to help. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avalon Healthcare Solutions****:** Avalon Healthcare Solutions is the nation’s leader in diagnostic intelligence, uniquely focused on transforming the role of diagnostic testing across the healthcare ecosystem. Our proprietary Diagnostic Insights Platform delivers evidence\-based policies, curated lab networks, and real\-time analytics that simplify complex diagnostics, accelerate innovation adoption, and optimize diagnostic investments. Supporting over 30 health plans and 100 million members nationwide, Avalon partners with payers and providers to ensure diagnostic testing is performed appropriately, efficiently, and at the right time. Our flexible solutions span routine and genetic testing management, automated adherence, and end\-to\-end diagnostics support—driving measurable value, reduced waste, and improved clinical outcomes. With unmatched scientific rigor, deep clinical expertise, and a performance\-based model, Avalon is redefining how diagnostics power personalized care and healthcare value. You will be part of a team that shapes a new market and business. Most importantly, you will help Avalon to achieve its mission and improve clinical outcomes and health care affordability for the people we serve. For more information about Avalon, please visit www.avalonhcs.com. Avalon Healthcare Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Vet/Disability. This position description is subject to change at any time. As determined by the company based upon business needs, an employee in this position may be required to perform duties and take responsibility for work other than as described in this document. **About the AI Engineer Position****:** The AI Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI\-powered solutions that support Avalon’s business objectives. This position owns complex AI features and projects from concept through production, including evaluating models and approaches, building reliable pipelines and integrations, and ensuring solutions meet high standards for accuracy, performance, and responsible use. While primarily focused on team objectives, the AI Engineer may also lead cross\-functional AI initiatives, coordinating efforts, aligning timelines, and partnering with Product, Design, and Data teams to translate business challenges into practical, measurable AI applications. This position works closely with principal engineers and architects to help shape AI strategy and technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions, and ensure AI systems remain consistent, secure, maintainable, and scalable across the platform. The AI Engineer serves as a key contributor to expanding AI expertise across the organization by mentoring employees, supporting adoption of AI tools and practices, providing code and model reviews, and promoting best practices related to prompt and model evaluation, data quality, observability, and responsible deployment. This role combines hands\-on technical execution with technical leadership and influence, helping advance Avalon’s AI capabilities while fostering a collaborative and innovative engineering culture. *This position is eligible for remote work, but quarterly travel will be required to Avalon’s corporate office located in Tampa, Florida.* **AI Engineer – Essential Functions and Responsibilities****:** * Contribute to the design, technical direction, and architecture of AI\-enabled solutions, collaborating with business and technical teams to build fit\-for\-purpose solutions that apply generative AI and agentic capabilities where they deliver measurable value. * Applies expert software engineering skills across a polyglot stack, including Python, Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, and Java, selecting the right language and runtime for each problem, and independently designs and develops key services with a focus on continuous integration and delivery. * Designs, builds, and operates agentic systems, including multi\-step and multi\-agent workflows, tool and function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and agent memory and orchestration patterns. * Applies advanced prompt engineering and context engineering practices, such as system prompt design, structured outputs, few\-shot examples, prompt chaining, and prompt versioning, to produce reliable, accurate, and cost\-effective model behavior. * Maps business processes and designs, builds, and maintains workflow automations using workflow orchestration platforms, with a strong preference for n8n, integrating AI agents with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources. * Establishes evaluation, testing, and observability practices for AI systems, including evaluation suites, regression testing of prompts and agents, guardrails, tracing, and monitoring of output quality, latency, and token cost. * Participates in code reviews, including review of prompts, agent co  in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related discipline; or the equivalent years of relevant business and technical experience. * A minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience in application software development and implementation, including hands\-on experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and AI tooling. * Strong proficiency in Python, Rust, GoLang, and Node.js/TypeScript, with working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem, and the judgment to choose the appropriate language for a given workload. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and SDKs (such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock) and agent frameworks (such as LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable tooling). * Demonstrated expertise in prompt engineering and agentic engineering, including tool use, MCP, RAG, structured outputs, and techniques for reducing hallucination and improving reliability. * Experience mapping business workflows and building automations in n8n (preferred) or comparable workflow and orchestration platforms such as Make, Zapier, Temporal, or Apache Airflow. * Experience developing applications using Docker, AWS EC2, ECS/Fargate and Apache Kafka. * Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (such as pgvector, OpenSearch, or Pinecone). * Experience using standard interface/integration architecture and techniques (REST, webhooks, event\-driven architecture, APIs, Microservices, SOA, SOAP/WSDL/XML, SAML). * Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain AI capabilities and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders. * History of working in an Agile software development environment. * “Get stuff done” and flexible mindset for the greater good of the organization. * Proven success delivering high\-quality solutions on time. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including engineers, product managers, and leadership. * Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a cross\-functional team, while also influencing technical direction and decision\-making within the team. * Demonstrates initiative and autonomy in identifying opportunities for improvement, driving solutions, and following through to execution. * Open to feedback and skilled at delivering constructive feedback to peers in a way that promotes growth, learning, and team cohesion. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and resolve complex technical challenges. * Consistently demonstrates ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions. * Actively mentors junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. * Comfortable stepping into informal leadership roles, such as guiding technical discussions or coordinating efforts on team\-level initiatives. **AI Engineer – Preferred Qualifications****:** * Healthcare knowledge or experience preferred. * Experience self\-hosting and administering n8n, including developing custom nodes and integrating n8n with AI agents and LLM services. * Experience building and evaluating RAG systems, embeddings, and model evaluation pipelines; familiarity with fine\-tuning is a plus. * Knowledge of AI security and safety practices, including guardrails, prompt injection mitigation, and responsible AI principles. * Experience working in an AWS or cloud\-based environment, including managed AI services such as AWS Bedrock. * Integration of rules engines with AI\-driven workflows. * Planning, developing, and deploying high\-volume, mission\-critical AI and software applications in a healthcare environment. * Knowledge or experience with HIPAA regulations and standards for security (PHI, IIHI), privacy, and transactions, particularly as they apply to the use of PHI with AI models and third\-party AI vendors.

Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Azure Storage, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or similar tools to support automated infrastructure deployments. * Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, troubleshoot issues, and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, and cost efficiency. * Collaborate with security teams to implement cloud security best practices, identity and access controls, and compliance requirements. * Support disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and high\-availability initiatives. * Work with cross\-functional technical teams to troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues and implement long\-term solutions. * Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, infrastructure configurations, and operational procedures. * Identify opportunities to modernize existing infrastructure and improve cloud operations through automation and emerging technologies. **Required Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role, with significant automation and scripting, particularly PowerShell. * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. * Solid understanding of Azure networking, practices. * Strong understanding of cloud security, infrastructure reliability, and operational best practices. * Proven ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues and develop practical, scalable solutions. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience supporting cloud infrastructure within Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\). * Experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and cloud jobs.title: Cloud Solution Architect – Security
jobs.description: **Cloud Solution Architect – Security** **Location:** United States (Remote) – Houston, TX preferred Invoke, the 2025 Microsoft Identity Partner of the Year and a top 10 U.S. Microsoft Security partner, is seeking a Cloud Solution Architect to guide customers from security strategy through implementation across cloud and hybrid environments, including the AI agents operating within them. As a trusted advisor, you’ll partner with business and IT leaders to assess security posture, shape roadmaps and target operating models, and define the policies, processes, and metrics that align to frameworks such as Zero Trust, NIST, and CIS. In delivery, you’ll design and deploy Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Security Copilot agents, and exposure management solutions, and use Microsoft Agent 365 to extend Microsoft Entra, Defender, and Purview controls to AI agents. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable advising executives and getting hands\-on, combining deep technical expertise with practical governance design and change management skills. **Responsibilities** In the Cloud Solution Architect role, you will lead customer\-facing engagements on some of the largest and most advanced security projects, guiding organizations as they modernize security operations and adopt Microsoft security capabilities across cloud, hybrid, and AI environments. Key responsibilities include: * **Security Strategy \& Advisory:** Assess security posture, build roadmaps and target operating models aligned to Zero Trust, NIST, and CIS, and serve as a trusted advisor to business and IT leaders through ongoing guidance. * **Security Operations:** Deploy Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel as a unified SIEM and XDR platform in the Microsoft Defender portal, including transitioning existing Sentinel environments from the Azure portal; build cross\-domain detections, automated response, and threat hunting enriched by Microsoft Threat Intelligence; and use Microsoft Security Copilot agents to accelerate triage, investigation, and response. * **Threat Prevention \& Hardening:** Implement Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Defender for Cloud to protect endpoints, email, identities, SaaS apps, and multi\-cloud workloads, including attack surface reduction, exploit and network protection, and phishing defenses. * **Exposure \& Posture Management:** Use Microsoft Security Exposure Management, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, and cloud security posture management in Defender for Cloud to map attack paths, identify critical assets, and prioritize remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. * **Identity Threat Protection:** Enforce risk\-based Conditional Access with Microsoft Entra ID Protection, deploy phishing\-resistant authentication, and apply least\-privilege and just\-in\-time access with Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management to reduce credential theft and privilege escalation. * **Data Security:** Implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI to protect sensitive data across Microsoft 365, cloud apps, and AI tools. * **AI Agent Governance \& Security:** Implement Microsoft Agent 365 to discover, register, govern, and monitor enterprise AI agents; extend Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Defender, and Purview controls to agents; and establish lifecycle and operational policies for agent adoption. You will be responsible for the full engagement life cycle (discovery, analysis, design, implementation, and ongoing advisory) while confidently leading customer workshops and executive discussions. **General Requirements** * A minimum of 5 years of experience in IT consulting or professional services delivery. * A minimum of 2 years of experience as an Architect or Consultant for Microsoft Security solutions, such as Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Purview. * Experience advising executive and technical stakeholders on security strategy, priorities, and roadmaps. * Working knowledge of AI security risks and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply newly released Microsoft capabilities, such as Microsoft Agent 365, Microsoft Entra Agent ID, and Microsoft Security Copilot agents. * Confident presentation, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with customers and partners. * Highly motivated, collaborative team player with strong organizational and time management skills, able to work autonomously or with a team and help peers succeed. * Meticulous attention to detail. **Role Specific Requirements** * Proven design, planning, and implementation experience with most of the following: Microsoft Defender XDR (including Defender for Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, and Cloud Apps), Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Security Exposure Management, Microsoft Entra ID Protection, and Microsoft Purview. * Experience modernizing security operations, such as migrating from legacy SIEM platforms to Microsoft Sentinel or moving Sentinel into the Microsoft Defender portal. * Experience guiding customers through adoption of new security technologies, including Organizational Change Management and communications for end users, SOC and help desk teams, and stakeholders. * Proficiency with KQL for hunting and detection engineering, and with PowerShell, Logic Apps, and Microsoft Graph to automate and extend security capabilities. **Role Specific Preferred Experience** * Experience leading security engagements end to end, including scoping, solution design, and supporting technical pre\-sales and statements of work. * Hands\-on SOC, incident response, or threat hunting experience, including mapping detections to MITRE ATT\&CK. * Experience applying security frameworks such as Zero Trust, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls to customer environments. * Experience securing multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, and GCP) with Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Experience in design, implementation, and adoption of Microsoft Agent 365, Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Security Copilot agents, and Microsoft Purview controls for AI (such as Data Security Posture Management for AI). **Recommended Certifications** * Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\) * Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\) * Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate (SC\-500\) **Preferred Certifications** * Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\) * Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC\-401\) **Compensation** * This position is full\-time offering a base salary and monetary incentives. * Base salary range: $140,000 – $160,000 per year * A generous benefits package is also available to qualifying full\-time employees. **About Invoke** Invoke is a 100% Microsoft\-focused consulting firm that helps enterprises innovate securely. Our solutions span Security (Identity \& Access Management, Threat Protection, Data Security \& Governance, Cloud Infrastructure Security, and Endpoint Management) and AI Business Solutions. Our mission is to deliver long\-term business value as our customers’ trusted advisor, from strategic planning and roadmaps through implementation and ongoing operations. As one of 100 Microsoft Enterprise System Integrators, a top 10 U.S. Microsoft Security partner, and a Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA) member, Invoke was named the 2025 Microsoft Identity Partner of the Year and the 2026 MISA Security Services Partner of the Year, and was selected as a Microsoft Agent 365 launch partner. **Invoke Core Values** * **Be Results\-Driven:** We prioritize delivering measurable, impactful outcomes through focus, determination, and commitment. * **Lead with Integrity:** We operate with trust, ethical decision\-making, and reliability, fostering confidence in our commitments and relationships. * **Collaborate to Succeed:** We believe in the power of teamwork, open communication, and customer\-focused collaboration to achieve shared success. * **Innovate and Improve:** We continuously seek creative and scalable ways to refine how we work and deliver value, improving solutions across all areas of the business. * **Solve Problems Effectively:** We tackle challenges with creativity, focus, and sustainable solutions, ensuring long\-term success and stability. **Please view our website for further details:** InvokeLLC.com **or apply on LinkedIn Jobs.**

jobs.title: Electrical And Electronics Engineering AI Evaluator
jobs.description: We are seeking practicing electrical and electronics engineers to train and evaluate frontier AI models on real circuit\- and system\-level engineering work. This fully remote, project\-based contract requires at least 3 years of hands\-on industry experience, current or recent individual\-contributor practice, strong engineering judgment, and proficiency with circuit simulation, schematic and PCB tools, laboratory instruments, MATLAB or Python, and technical analysis. Contributors design realistic engineering tasks, assess model outputs, create grading rubrics, and document technical failures against professional standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Design problems through frontier AI models and evaluate the resulting deliverables against professional engineering standards. * Compare model versions using identical prompts and supporting material, determine which model performed better, and document the reasons for the assessment. * Critique model\-generated derivations, schematics, component selections, simulation setups, and design calculations for technical correctness. * Develop detailed grading rubrics that define what constitutes a correct deliverable and explain the engineering rationale behind each judgment. * Identify and document concrete failures, including incorrect assumptions, sign and unit errors, unphysical results, invalid component or topology choices, misapplied approximations, fabricated datasheet values, and misread schematics or plots. * Contribute expertise across relevant engineering domains, including analog, RF and mixed\-signal circuits, electromagnetics, microwaves and antennas, control and systems, electronic devices and materials, signal processing, photonics and optoelectronics, and electric power and energy systems. * Review and refine tasks created by other engineers and provide precise feedback grounded in professional engineering practice. * Propose engineering scenarios from your own experience, complete accepted tasks through expert review, and revise deliverables based on feedback before progressing to subsequent project stages. **Required Qualifications** * At least **3 years of industry experience** in circuit or electronics engineering, with 5 or more years considered a plus. * Current or recent experience performing technical work as an individual contributor rather than solely in a managerial capacity. * Background in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, or a closely related discipline. * In\-progress Bachelor's degree or higher, as specified in the must\-have qualifications. * Strong command of circuit analysis and design tradeoffs, including the ability to defend component\-level and system\-level decisions. * Fluency with circuit simulation, including SPICE and similar tools, schematic capture and PCB tools, laboratory instruments, and MATLAB or Python for engineering analysis. * Hands\-on experience with circuit design, hardware design, hardware debugging, board bring\-up, and technical engineering workflows. * Strong written communication and the ability to explain complex professional reasoning and articulate why an answer is wrong, not only that it is wrong. * General familiarity with AI and LLM tools, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Attention to detail, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to verify claims against underlying numbers, sources, or facts. * Ability to interpret feedback, determine which parts are correct, and apply revisions independently. * Baseline technology literacy, including cloud file tools, browser profiles, desktop applications, and everyday file handling. * Availability for at least 10 hours per week. The project prioritizes 30–40 hours per week, with no weekly maximum. * Professional or native\-level written and spoken English. * Ability to complete the assessment and project work independently; submissions produced with AI tools are rejected. * Location in the United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Ireland, or New Zealand. **Benefits and Perks** * Fully remote, project\-based contract work with flexible scheduling. * Competitive compensation of **$70–$200 per hour USD**, with bonus rates available on some projects. * Payment through PayPal on a regular cadence. * Access to Claude and ChatGPT through the project; no personal subscription is required. * Flexible multi\-day task timers that allow contributors to spread work across days. * No shift work and no weekly maximum after the 10\-hour minimum. * Opportunities to work on advanced AI evaluation projects grounded in real electrical and electronics engineering practice. * Paid compensation for completed project stages that are accepted through the review process. **Note: This hiring is for Scrini AI** Pay: $70\.00 \- $200\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Title: Facilities Manager** **Location: Sugar Land, Texas** We are looking for a **F****acilities Manager** \[BH1] to supervise and coordinate the activities and operations of the Operations Department, with a strong emphasis on electrical systems, plumbing, and commercial HVAC operations, including safety, security, and event staffing functions; to provide highly responsible staff assistance to the Director of Operations. This role requires extensive hands\-on oversight of commercial HVAC infrastructure, electrical systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization, ensuring all building systems operate efficiently, safely, and in compliance with applicable codes and standards. Strong technical expertise in electrical, plumbing, and HVAC disciplines is essential. **Benefits for Full\-Time roles: Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and holidays).** **Responsibilities** * Assume management responsibility for all activities involved in the maintenance and operation of the facility, with a strong emphasis on electrical systems, plumbing systems and commercial HVAC operations, in addition to mechanical, and general maintenance. * Plan, direct, coordinate, and review the work plan for facility maintenance and operations; meet with staff to identify and resolve complex electrical, plumbing and HVAC system issues; assign work activities, projects, and programs; monitor workflow; and evaluate work products, methods, and procedures. * Ensure compliance with maintenance standards and reporting practices required by the Agreement with the City of Sugar Land, including effective management of all systems to optimize preventive and corrective maintenance programs, with emphasis on HVAC and electrical asset tracking, reliability, and performance management. * Oversee the setup of utility services for events; coordinate facility arrangements with concessionaires; and assist the Director of Operations in directing and monitoring contractors, engineers, and architects on capital projects, with emphasis on electrical infrastructure and commercial HVAC systems. * Participate in the development and administration of the Maintenance Engineering Department budget, including forecasting staffing, equipment, materials, and supplies with specific focus on electrical and HVAC system reliability, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle replacement needs; monitor expenditures and recommend approvals or adjustments. * Maintain hazardous materials communication programs, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and required permits, ensuring compliance with all applicable Federal, State, and Local regulations related to electrical and HVAC operations and facility maintenance. * Perform related duties and responsibilities as required in a team\-oriented environment that promotes exceptional service delivery, safety, and operational excellence, with a strong focus on electrical and commercial HVAC system performance and reliability. **Qualifications** * Strong electrical and commercial HVAC experience required, with demonstrated hands\-on expertise in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining complex building systems in large\-scale facilities. * Extensive experience in the repair and maintenance of commercial HVAC systems, including solid\-state controls, chillers, VAV boxes, AHUs, fan coil units, and DX systems. * Proficiency in the operation of computer\-based Building Management Systems (BMS), along with sufficient computer skills to effectively use standard office applications for reporting, maintenance tracking, and system diagnostics. * Strong working knowledge of electrical systems maintenance and repair, along with experience maintaining major facility systems including plumbing, structural components, painting, grounds, and interior finishes in large, client\-centered operations. * Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and standards related to facility maintenance, electrical safety, and HVAC operations. * Experience in Entertainment, Convention Center or Hospitality environments is strongly preferred, particularly in high\-volume, public\-facing facilities requiring rapid response and operational reliability. * Minimum of four (4\) years of building maintenance experience, including at least two (2\) years in a supervisory or lead capacity overseeing electrical and HVAC trades personnel. * Minimum education jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Robotics Engineer** **Skyforge Industries, Inc.** is developing autonomous robotic systems for the construction and assembly of large structures in space. We’re looking for a hands\-on and hungry robotics engineer with the passion and capability to learn and grow with the company as we progress. Growth into a co\-founder role is possible.Must be able to work on US export\-controlled technology.Preferably located in the Greater Boston metropolitan area, or open to relocation. We’re able to offer you the startup trifecta: **Salary, equity, and benefits on the ground floor of something nobody’s brought to market yet.** **You don’t need to have worked on space hardware or in aerospace, so we encourage you to reach out even if you think you might not be a perfect fit. We want someone who can learn and grow with us.** You’ll get to help direct the future of our technology stack from day 1, and collaborate to drive the technical aspect of our company. You’ll work across mechanical design, actuators, sensors, controls, embedded hardware, software, fabrication, and testing. You should be comfortable moving between CAD, code, electronics, and a workbench. **What You'll Work On** You’ll build the first iteration of our robotic platform, which includes: * multiple, multi\-joint robotic manipulators * Interchangeable grippers and end effectors * Motorized joints with position feedback * Motion planning * IMUs and other onboard sensors, perception * Force/torque or load sensing * Test rigging for 6DoF maneuverability * A ROS 2\-based interface to higher\-level autonomy software **Responsibilities** * Own and help direct the future of the robotics technology stack * Design and build robotic grippers if needed, and supporting mechanisms * Design the structural chassis and mechanical architecture of the prototype * Develop and tune joint\-level position, velocity, and torque controllers * Implement forward and inverse kinematics for multi\-DoF manipulators * Develop motion planning algorithms, A\*, RRT, PRM, etc * Characterize manipulator workspace, payload capability, stiffness, backlash, and repeatability * Integrate IMUs, encoders, limit sensors, force sensors, and related instrumentation * Develop ROS 2 hardware interfaces and expose reliable control primitives to the autonomy stack * Design and integrate the air\-bearing/free\-motion test platform * Model and characterize robot mass properties, inertia, reaction forces, and coupled arm/platform motion * Build test fixtures and experimental setups * Perform calibration, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, troubleshooting, and failure analysis * Work closely with the Automation Engineer to define interfaces between physical robot control and autonomous planning * Document designs, interfaces, test results, and lessons learned as the prototype evolves **Required Skills** * Strong fundamentals in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field * Experience physically building and integrating robotic systems * Robotic manipulator kinematics and dynamics * Feedback control, including PID and trajectory control * Mechanical CAD experience with SolidWorks, NX, Creo, Fusion 360, or similar * C\+\+ and/or Python * Ability to integrate sensors, actuators, embedded controllers, and mechanical systems * Comfortable debugging complex hardware/software interactions * Ability to perform engineering calculations for torque, gearing, inertia, acceleration, loads, deflection, and power requirements * Comfortable fabricating, modifying, assembling, and repairing prototype hardware **Strongly Preferred** Experience with any of the following is valuable but **not required**: * **Multi\-arm robotic systems** * ROS 2 and ros2\_control * Force/torque or impedance control; Optimal and/or Adaptive Controls * BLDC motor control * CAN/CAN\-FD, EtherCAT, UART, SPI, or similar hardware interfaces * Linux\-based robotic systems * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing * Motion planning using A\*, RRT, RRT\*, PRM * Robot simulation using Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar * Perception using SLAM, object recognition * CNC machining, additive manufacturing, or rapid prototyping experience * Free\-floating robotics * Spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control * Microgravity robotics * Air\-bearing spacecraft testbeds * Reaction\-control systems * Space\-rated mechanisms * Vacuum or thermal\-vacuum testing * Multi\-body dynamics * Orbital servicing, assembly, or manufacturing We care more about whether you can **build and debug a complex robot** than your academics or your employment history. **What Success Looks Like** You should be able to take a subsystem from an engineering requirement or functional specification to operating hardware. The work will provide the reliable physical platform on top of which Skyforge's autonomous assembly system operates. Pay: $96,400\.00 \- $117,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Stock options People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** ============================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI systems become increasingly capable, progress depends not only on better models, but on the quality of the data, environments, and feedback used to train them. We build the infrastructure that makes this possible. Our work spans clinical reasoning, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We combine deep domain expertise with software infrastructure to generate high\-quality training data, evaluate model behavior, and develop reinforcement learning environments for increasingly autonomous AI systems. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** to build the platform that powers the creation, curation, evaluation, and delivery of high\-quality data for frontier AI models. You'll work on a sophisticated platform that coordinates domain experts, AI models, automated evaluation systems, and complex data production workflows. Our platform enables scientists, physicians, and other experts to create and validate training data, develop evaluation tasks, annotate model outputs, and collaborate with AI\-assisted tools. Behind the scenes, it orchestrates multi\-stage workflows, manages large datasets, tracks quality, and transforms expert knowledge into structured, machine\-consumable outputs. This isn't a conventional annotation tool or CRUD application. We're building an intelligent data production system where human expertise, model\-generated content, programmatic validation, and automated feedback loops work together at scale. You'll have significant ownership across the product and infrastructure stack, working directly with the founding team, researchers, and domain experts to turn complex data creation processes into intuitive, reliable, and scalable software. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build the data creation platform:** Design and implement core product features that enable experts to create, annotate, review, validate, and refine complex training and evaluation datasets. * **Develop intelligent workflows:** Build flexible, multi\-stage pipelines combining human contributions, AI\-generated content, automated evaluation, and expert review. * **Build AI\-native interfaces:** Develop tools that enable experts to collaborate effectively with AI models, including AI\-assisted annotation, content generation, feedback, and validation. * **Engineer data infrastructure:** Build robust systems for dataset storage, versioning, lineage, transformations, quality control, and delivery. * **Develop task orchestration:** Implement assignment, routing, dependencies, review queues, quality gates, and workflow automation across distributed teams of experts. * **Build evaluation and quality systems:** Integrate model\-based judges, programmatic verifiers, consensus mechanisms, and quality metrics to ensure data reliability. * **Create exceptional product experiences:** Build fast, intuitive interfaces for complex scientific and healthcare workflows, balancing flexibility with simplicity. * **Integrate frontier AI models:** Develop infrastructure for model inference, structured generation, prompt execution, and automated feedback loops. * **Scale the platform:** Improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience as data volume, workflow complexity, and expert participation grow. * **Own systems end to end:** Drive technical decisions from product design and system architecture through implementation, deployment, and iteration. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Strong proficiency in **TypeScript and Python**, with experience building sophisticated, production\-grade applications. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js, and a strong understanding of frontend architecture and application state management. * Solid backend engineering experience, including APIs, relational databases, asynchronous processing, and distributed services. * Experience designing complex data models, workflow systems, and scalable application infrastructure. * Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, queues, background jobs, caching, and cloud infrastructure. * Ability to build thoughtful user experiences for technically complex products. * Strong product intuition and the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into elegant, maintainable solutions. * Demonstrated ability to independently architect, ship, and iterate on comple arly excited if you have** * Experience building data annotation, labeling, evaluation, or human\-in\-the\-loop platforms. * Experience with AI training data pipelines, dataset curation, synthetic data generation, or model evaluation. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, structured generation, tool calling, prompt management, and AI\-assisted workflows. * Experience building workflow orchestration systems, task queues, or configurable workflow engines. * Knowledge of data versioning, provenance, lineage, schema validation, and reproducibility. * Experience designing collaborative tools involving review, approvals, permissions, and complex state transitions. * Background in developer tools, internal platforms, scientific software, or other technically demanding products. * Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, or scientific datasets. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy difficult problems, move quickly, and take pride in creating exceptional software. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, understand users deeply, and are comfortable owning problems without a predefined playbook. * **Quantitative trading and high\-performance engineering:** Engineers accustomed to demanding technical environments, complex systems, and high standards for correctness and reliability. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who enjoy difficult technical and mathematical challenges. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong engineering skills with an interest in logic, reasoning, formal systems, and the foundations of intelligence. * **Makers and independent builders:** People who build ambitious side projects, open\-source software, robots, hardware, or unconventional tools simply because they love creating things. These aren't requirements. They're examples of the intellectual curiosity, independence, and builder mentality we value. We're particularly interested in engineers who can think like product designers, reason like systems engineers, and execute like founders. We care more about what you've built and how you think than where you've worked or which credentials you hold. **What We're Offering** ----------------------- * **Build infrastructure for frontier AI:** Develop the systems that turn human expertise and scientific knowledge into high\-quality data for training and evaluating advanced AI models. * **Significant product and technical ownership:** Shape the architecture, user experience, and evolution of a core platform from early design through production. * **Complex, meaningful engineering challenges:** Work on human\-AI collaboration, workflow orchestration, data systems, model integration, and quality infrastructure. * **Direct exposure to frontier AI research:** Collaborate with researchers, scientists, and domain experts to understand how models fail and what data they need to improve. * **Build products used by real experts:** Create tools used by physicians, scientists, and researchers to produce and validate complex data. * **Small, high\-caliber team:** Work directly with founders and exceptional engineers in a fast\-moving, intellectually demanding environment. * **Freedom to experiment:** Prototype quickly, challenge assumptions, and pursue better approaches without unnecessary bureaucracy. * **Competitive compensation and meaningful equity:** Participate in the long\-term value you help create. * **Opportunity to shape the company:** Help define our engineering culture, product architecture, and the future of AI data infrastructure. We're looking for people who want to build more than another software platform — people who want to create the infrastructure through which human expertise becomes machine intelligence. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments & Sandboxes
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** =========================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI moves beyond answering questions toward executing complex scientific workflows, models need more than training data. They need environments where they can interact with tools, make decisions, execute experiments, observe consequences, and learn from verifiable outcomes. We build those environments. Our work spans clinical systems, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We're developing both computational environments and environments connected to physical wet\-lab infrastructure, bridging AI agents with real scientific instruments, robotic systems, and experimental workflows. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** to build high\-fidelity environments where frontier AI agents learn to perform complex, real\-world tasks. You'll design and implement stateful, executable environments that allow agents to interact with software, APIs, scientific tools, and laboratory systems. These environments must be reproducible, verifiable, and scalable enough to support reinforcement learning and rigorous evaluation. This role is particularly exciting because your work won't be limited to simulated software. You'll work closely with our wet\-lab team to build the infrastructure connecting AI agents to physical experiments, laboratory automation, and real biological outcomes. You'll own systems end to end, from environment architecture and sandbox execution to tool interfaces, task verification, and rollout infrastructure. We're looking for someone who enjoys working at the boundary of software, AI, and the physical world — someone who would be equally excited about building a distributed execution engine and making a laboratory robot perform an experiment. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build RL environments:** Design and implement realistic, stateful environments that reproduce complex workflows across healthcare, biology, and scientific software. * **Develop secure sandboxes:** Build isolated, reproducible execution environments supporting agent\-generated code, tool calls, filesystem operations, and application interactions. * **Connect AI agents to the wet lab:** Work with scientists and automation engineers to integrate laboratory instruments, robotic liquid handlers, experimental protocols, and biological readouts into agent\-accessible workflows. * **Build agent\-facing tools:** Implement MCP servers, APIs, and interfaces that enable agents to interact with software applications, scientific instruments, and simulated systems. * **Engineer state management:** Develop deterministic initialization, snapshot/restore, state transitions, resets, and execution replay. * **Develop tasks and verifiers:** Translate real\-world workflows into executable tasks with clear success criteria, ground\-truth states, and programmatic verification. * **Scale environment execution:** Build orchestration infrastructure for high\-throughput parallel rollouts, supporting both simulated environments and physical experiments with appropriate execution controls. * **Work with Harbor:** Develop, integrate, and validate environments using Harbor\-compatible task structures, execution harnesses, and evaluation workflows. * **Improve environment fidelity:** Identify unrealistic shortcuts, hidden state inconsistencies, and verification gaps that could compromise training quality. * **Own the full lifecycle:** Take ambitious technical ideas from early prototypes through production\-grade infrastructure. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Excellent Python skills and strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, systems design, and software architecture. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Linux, containers, process isolation, or sandbox execution. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, state management, and reliability. * Experience designing complex APIs, backend systems, and integrations. * Ability to independently architect, build, debug, and ship sophisticated technical systems. **We'd be particularly excited if you have** * Hands\-on experience with **Harbor**, especially building custom RL environments, task definitions, verifiers, or evaluation infrastructure. * Experience with RL environments, AI agents, model evaluation, or agent training infrastructure. * Familiarity with MCP, Gymnasium, Ray, or similar agent and execution frameworks. * Experience with robotics, laboratory automation, hardware interfaces, or cyber\-physical systems. * Knowledge of deterministic simulation, sandbox orchestration, reproducible execution, and reward verification. * Experience with scientific computing, bioinformatics, or computational biology. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy unusually difficult problems and have a track record of pursuing ambitious ideas beyond what's expected of them. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, are comfortable with ambiguity, and naturally take ownership. * **Quantitative trading and low\-latency engineering:** Engineers from quantitative trading firms or similarly demanding environments who have developed exceptional problem\-solving skills, strong systems intuition, and a high bar for correctness. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who genuinely enjoy difficult technical and mathematical problems. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong technical reasoning with an interest in logic, epistemology, formal systems, and foundational questions about intelligence. * **Makers and tinkerers:** People who build robots, hardware, electronics, open\-source tools, or ambitious hobby projects simply because they find them interesting. These aren't requirements or substitutes for demonstrated engineering ability. They're examples of the curiosity, intellectual intensity, and builder mentality we value. We care much more about what you've built, how you think, and how quickly you learn than about credentials or conventional career paths. **What We're Offering** ----------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI and science:** Build infrastructure that enables advanced AI agents to interact with real scientific systems and tackle meaningful problems in biology and medicine. * **Bridge software and the physical world:** Work directly with wet\-lab infrastructure, laboratory robotics, and experimental workflows — not just simulations or datasets. * **Exceptional technical ownership:** Shape fundamental architectural decisions and own critical systems from concept to production. * **Hard, unsolved problems:** Tackle challenges involving secure execution, distributed systems, real\-world simulation, robotics, and reinforcement learning. * **Small, high\-caliber team:** Collaborate directly with founders, AI researchers, scientists, and engineers who care deeply about their craft. * **Freedom to build:** Work in an environment that encourages experimentation, rapid prototyping, intellectual independence, and unconventional approaches. * **Competitive compensation and meaningful equity:** Participate in the long\-term value you help create. * **Room to grow:** Help define the technical foundations and engineering culture of an ambitious company at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We're looking for people who don't just want to build software, but want to build systems that expand what intelligence can do in the real world. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

We are seeking a talented independent software developer to help us build a modern replacement for our website's backend and editorial publishing platform. **This is primarily a software development and backend modernization project, not a visual redesign.** The existing public\-facing ArtDaily design should remain substantially unchanged. Project Responsibilities Develop a modern content management system that allows editors to create and manage articles, including: * Headlines and subheadlines * Article text and formatting * Main and additional images * Image captions and photo credits * Categories and author/source information * Publication dates and scheduling * Homepage placement * SEO information * Sponsored/promoted content identification Editors must be able to create, edit, preview, schedule, publish, unpublish, and search articles through a user\-friendly administrative interface. The project also involves migrating ArtDaily's historical content while preserving existing article URLs wherever possible. Technical Requirements Experience with several of the following is desirable: * Backend web development * Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server) * Content management systems * APIs and data migration * Modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python * Cloud hosting (AWS, Azure, or similar) * CDN, caching, and website performance * Cloudflare or comparable security solutions * Backups and disaster recovery * Git version control, testing, and documentation We are open to different modern technology stacks, including Python/Django, Node.js/TypeScript, modern .NET, PHP/Laravel, or established CMS frameworks. Ideal Candidate We welcome experienced independent developers, talented recent graduates, and advanced computer science students. We value demonstrated technical ability more than years of employment. Candidates should be able to show real software projects they have built, explain technical decisions, and work independently. Experience with legacy systems, content migration, or digital publishing is particularly valuable. UT Austin students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. How to Apply Please include your GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of software you have personally developed. Briefly answer: * What is the most complicated web application you have personally built? * Have you developed an administrative panel or content management system? * What databases have you worked with? * Have you deployed an application to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or another production server? * How would you replace an old website backend while keeping the public\-facing website largely unchanged? Opportunity This is a paid, project\-based opportunity with the potential for ongoing work maintaining and improving ArtDaily after the initial modernization. We are looking for a dependable, technically capable professional interested in building a long\-term working relationship with an established international publication. Language Requirements. We welcome applicants who speak Englesh and Spanish. Candidates may communicate and interview in either language. Pay: $25\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Description** --------------- The Software Engineer develops information systems by designing, programming, and installing software solutions in support of the business. This position is responsible for full life cycle of software development process: design, code, test, deploy, document and maintain application software in web\-based and non web\-based environments. **This position requires a minimum of three (3\) days in\-person per week.** *Ensure a commitment to safety through consistent and professional behaviors in performance of job requirements. Serve as a good steward of TriMet and maintain a strong and current understanding of customers’ experiences and of TriMet’s product and service offerings.* *Reliable in\-person attendance is an essential function of all positions. TriMet is an in\-person first organization, with a strong emphasis on in\-person collaboration, customer service, and safe and efficient operations. Some positions may be able to work up to two days remotely depending on department policy, business needs, and manager discretion.* **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Responsible for all aspects of enterprise application technical ownership and development in a web environment using web technology. Participates in the entire application lifecycle, including gathering requirements; project scoping, identifying development needs; choosing appropriate programming language and identifying development frameworks that could expedite the process; determining cross\-platform integration capability; configuring, integrating, and coding the application system. Ensures proper source code stewardship by enforcing proper source control discipline ensuring the appropriate repositories are up to date with the latest version of source code. * Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development and proposed solutions. Prepare and install solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming. * Conduct automated unit, functional, user acceptance, and integration testing to ensure product fulfills requirements of the end user and integrates correctly with other systems. * Document and demonstrate solution by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code. * Improve operations by conducting systems analysis and recommend changes in policies and procedures. * Licenses software by obtaining required information from vendors, recommend purchases, test and approve products. * Apply sound project management guidelines to ensure the accurate and timely completion of assigned tasks and projects. Prepare and communicate project plans and project status. * Provide technical ownership for one or more major enterprise business applications, including ongoing customer and technical support. Gather and analyze information for correcting or improving systems. Make appropriate changes to ensure the ongoing operational integrity of the system. * Coordinate with Customer and Information Technology management to establish resource levels and priorities to ensure appropriate levels of product and customer support are in place. * Contribute to the development of technology standards and best practices. Research and evaluate emerging technologies for inclusion within Agency’s enterprise application environment. **Position Requirements** ------------------------- A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree is required. A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, GIS, Physics, or Engineering is preferred. A minimum of two (2\) years total credited experience.\* Two (2\) years of experience working in an Information Technology group or R\&D software lab are required. Two (2\) years of experience working with in an IT group or R\&D software lab in a web\-based software development capacity are required. Or any equivalent combination of training or experience. * The amount of credit a candidate receives for prior years of experience is based on the relevancy of that experience to the required or preferred prerequisites of the job description. Experience is prorated based on hours worked. LRHR assigns and validates the "credited experience". Salary offers will be determined by a candidate's education, training and relevant experience. A complete work history will be required for this purpose at the time of offer; any omitted work history will not be considered after hire. Any final offer of employment will fall within the range stated above. For transparency, we choose to list the full available grade range, however, TriMet's salary administration process will ultimately determine the final salary offered. **Selection Criteria** ---------------------- **Type of Position / Grade / FLSA** Grade 16, Exempt, Non\-Union, Full\-Time **Salary Range** Minimum: $104,587\.00 Maximum: $156,881\.00 **Selection Process** Candidates will be selected based at a minimum on the result of: 1\. Application Review (please include: Cover Letter and Resume) 2\. Panel Interviews 3\. Reference Check and Degree Verification 4\. Criminal Background Check **Supplemental Information** Make sure you describe in detail how your education, training and work experience fit with this role. You are encouraged to attach a resume, cover letter, training certificates and/or letters of recommendation with your application. You are permitted five attachments of less than 5MB each. Internal applicants: Information in your personnel file will not be used in lieu of information requested on your application. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you are a qualified veteran and would like to apply for veterans' preference points, you will need to reflect your status on the application and attach supporting documentation at the time of application submission. If you need accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act for any part of the application process, contact our Human Resources staff at 503\-962\-7505, or the TTY line at 7\-1\-1\. Note that we require a minimum of two workdays' notice prior to the need for accommodation. TriMet is an equal opportunity employer, committed to developing an organization that is reflective of and sensitive to the needs of the diverse community we serve, including veterans, the elderly, and individuals with disabilities. **ADA Statement** As applied to the workplace, applicants and employees must be qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. Essential functions may include required job functions performed infrequently as well as production standards related to the quality and quantity of work. If a person with a disability could meet job qualifications with a reasonable accommodation, TriMet will work with the employee to accommodate the need. If TriMet's accommodation is effective in allowing the employee to perform the essential functions of the job, it need not be the employee's preferred accommodation.

jobs.title: Strategic AI Partnerships Lead
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero\-touch enterprise: context\-aware agents that operate inside highly customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, live operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high\-tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. **Role Summary** ---------------- We’re hiring a Strategic AI Partnerships Lead to build and grow FlowGen’s most important enterprise relationships, from the first conversation through signed contracts, successful deployments, and expansion. You’ll combine the commercial ownership of an enterprise account executive, the judgment of an AI strategist, and the execution of an engagement leader. You will identify new customers, build executive trust, develop a compelling business case, and close strategic deals. You will then stay accountable for making sure the customer gets what was sold: a well\-scoped deployment, strong adoption, and measurable business impact. Working closely with the founders, Forward Deployed Engineers, and product team, you’ll turn complex finance and operations problems into AI programs that customers trust and use. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can move comfortably between a boardroom, a commercial negotiation, and a working session with the people running the process. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts end to end, with accountability for new revenue, successful delivery, customer outcomes, retention, and expansion. * Generate net\-new opportunities through targeted account research, direct outreach, executive relationships, referrals, and industry events. Build a repeatable pipeline of enterprises where FlowGen can create material value. * Develop strategic partnerships with relevant technology providers, systems integrators, and industry networks to open doors, shape joint opportunities, and bring FlowGen into new accounts. * Lead discovery with finance, operations, and technology teams. Understand process steps, exceptions, controls, data sources, and manual workarounds; prioritize AI workflows based on business value, technical feasibility, and organizational readiness. * Run the full sales cycle from qualification and solution development through proposals, pricing, procurement, security review, negotiation, and close. Build executive sponsorship and business cases for six\-figure and above ACV deals. * Align customers and internal teams on scope, success metrics, milestones, resources, and acceptance criteria before commitments are made. Work with engineering to ensure the solution is feasible and the delivery plan supports what was sold. * Lead the customer engagement through implementation and production adoption. Coordinate Forward Deployed Engineers, AI strategists, product teams, and customer stakeholders; manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and executive communication. * Stay accountable until the deployment delivers measurable results. Track outcomes such as cycle\-time reduction, touchless processing, error reduction, working\-capital improvement, and support\-cost reduction, and drive action when results fall short. * Build durable relationships with executives and frontline users. Lead business reviews, resolve escalations, and turn successful deployments into renewals, references, and expansion across workflows and business units. * Maintain clear account plans, accurate forecasts, and disciplined CRM records. Partner with the founders to refine our positioning, sales and delivery playbooks, and feed customer insights into the product roadmap. **Who You Are** --------------- * 7\+ years in enterprise software sales, strategic partnerships, management consulting, or enterprise transformation, with demonstrated ownership of both commercial growth and customer delivery. * A track record of originating and winning new enterprise business. You can point to deals you personally helped source, shape, negotiate, and close, and explain the outcomes delivered afterward. * Experience leading complex customer engagements with multiple business and technical stakeholders, ideally at Fortune 500 or Global 2000 companies. * Strong executive presence and analytical judgment. You can translate an ambiguous operational problem into a quantified business case and an executable deployment plan. * Practical fluency with AI, automation, and enterprise software. You can discuss agentic workflows, integrations, data readiness, reliability, and human oversight with technical teams and explain the business implications clearly. * A disciplined operator who can manage parallel workstreams, surface risks early, hold owners accountable, and earn customer trust through consistent follow\-through. * Comfortable in an early\-stage environment, working directly on opportunities while building the processes and team practices that help us scale. * Familiarity with SAP, ERP, finance operations, supply chain, procurement, or order management is a plus. Curiosity and the ability to develop deep domain expertise matter. **Why Join** ------------ * Own visible, measurable outcomes at some of the world’s largest enterprises, from winning the relationship to delivering the impact. * Work at the intersection of frontier AI, enterprise operations, and deeply customized SAP environments. * Partner directly with founders and an unusually strong team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. * Shape FlowGen’s revenue, product direction, deployment methodology, and customer strategy at an early stage. * A high bar for velocity, ownership, customer trust, and pragmatic execution. **Compensation** ---------------- $300K–$450K annual on\-target earnings (OTE), comprising base salary and performance\-based variable compensation, plus equity. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: Hybrid (located in the US) * Travel: Regular customer travel across the US and Europe, as required by the engagement * Visa support and sponsorship available Compensation Range: $300K \- $450K

jobs.title: Strategy Manager, Office of the CEO
jobs.description: **Team:** Office of the CEO **Reports to:** Founder \& CEO **Location:** Sawtelle, Los Angeles, CA (onsite, five days per week) **Employment type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000, plus equity Plug's Founder \& CEO needs someone who can take the company's most important open questions (where to grow, what the numbers are really saying, whether an opportunity is worth pursuing) and come back with the analysis, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it. This is an analytical role first. It is not an administrative Chief of Staff, EA, or PMO role. **About Plug** -------------- Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing and battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end to end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $150M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles: operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. **Why this role** ----------------- As Plug grows, the number of priorities competing for the CEO's attention is growing with it. Many of the most important ones don't sit neatly inside one function: a marketplace economics question, a new market to evaluate, a board discussion that needs a sharper answer, a strategic tradeoff with incomplete data. You'll own that work. You'll take a loosely defined problem, structure it, get to the data, form a point of view, and drive it to a decision and then to execution. You'll work directly with the Founder \& CEO and across Plug's leadership team. **Your mission** ---------------- Take important, ambiguous problems off the CEO's plate and come back with a better answer than he'd have gotten by doing the work himself. Then make sure it gets done. **What you will own** --------------------- **Business analysis and recommendations.** Own the CEO's hardest analytical questions: marketplace liquidity, unit economics, pricing, growth, and customer behavior. Form hypotheses, pull and pressure\-test the data yourself, and land on a recommendation with clear tradeoffs. **CEO strategic projects.** Lead high\-priority, cross\-functional projects end to end. Define the problem, structure the work, drive to a decision, and hand off or execute. **New opportunities and business cases.** Size markets and evaluate new products, segments, and partnerships. Build the model and the business case, and tell the CEO whether it's worth pursuing and why. **Market and competitive intelligence.** Track EV, automotive retail, and fintech dynamics and competitors. Distill them into implications for Plug, not summaries. **Board, investor, and fundraising materials.** Own the analysis and narrative behind board decks, investor updates, and fundraising materials. Gather inputs across the company and turn them into a clear, defensible story. **AI\-native execution.** Use AI aggressively for research, analysis, synthesis, drafting, and workflow automation. We're looking for someone who naturally asks, "How can I do this faster and better?" before adding process or headcount. **Driving CEO priorities to completion.** Once a decision is made, make sure it happens. Turn CEO and leadership\-team decisions into clear owners and next steps, and keep the handful of priorities that matter most moving. The subject matter will change as the company grows. **Continuous improvement.** Look for friction in how we make decisions and get work done. Identify what's slow, manual, repetitive, or no longer serving us, and fix it with data, AI, automation, or simply a better way of working. Don't preserve a process because "that's how we've always done it." **What success looks like after 12 months** ------------------------------------------- * You've led several CEO\-sponsored projects from question to decision to execution, and at least one has materially changed a Plug decision on pricing, market entry, or resource allocation. * The CEO hands you ambiguous questions without a detailed brief and trusts what comes back. * You own the analytical backbone of board and investor materials. The CEO edits; he doesn't draft. * You've surfaced at least one problem or opportunity nobody asked you to look at. * You've replaced at least one slow, manual wo cise memo or a clear CEO\- or board\-level presentation. * **Strong Excel modeling skills.** * **High ownership.** You don't wait for someone to give you every step. * **Constructive challenge.** You're comfortable working directly with senior executives and pushing back when the data says something different. * **Follow\-through.** You'll do the unglamorous work required to get something across the finish line. * **Real AI usage.** You can point to specific ways AI has changed how you research, model, or write, not just that you use it. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth technology company * Marketplace, automotive, fintech, mobility, or consumer technology experience * Experience preparing board, investor, or fundraising materials * Market sizing and competitive analysis * SQL **How we operate** ------------------ We hire builders who value ownership, velocity, curiosity, and measurable outcomes. We move quickly, decide with data, and treat AI as a core operating principle. The people who do well here scope their own work, run their own process, and keep several workstreams moving without being managed closely. They're comfortable with complexity and ambiguity and can take a partly defined problem and come back with a plan. This role tracks the CEO's pace. Expect frequent evening and weekend work, particularly around board meetings, fundraising, and high\-priority projects. **High agency. Low ego. Bias for action.** **Why Plug** ------------ * You'll work directly with the Founder \& CEO on the company's highest\-priority problems: strategy, board discussions, investors, new opportunities, and marketplace economics. * You'll get exposure across the business rather than sitting inside one function. * You'll have real ownership and a direct line to company outcomes. * You'll work alongside operators who have scaled multi\-billion\-dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company that's rethinking how work gets done. **Not sure you should apply? Do it.** ------------------------------------- Research consistently shows that people from under\-represented groups are more likely to talk themselves out of applying if they don't meet 100% of the listed requirements. You don't need to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of what's listed under "What we need from you," we want to hear from you. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000, plus equity Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, business needs, and market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted. * Health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch and dinner stipend * Equity * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * On\-site EV charging This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is in person five days per week. We welcome candidates from all locations who are willing to relocate; relocation assistance is available. Visa sponsorship is not available at this time. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diverse teams build better products. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.description: **Advanced Space \| Full\-time \| Hybrid** ========================================== **We're going to the Moon.
