reliable, testable code. * You're analytical and enjoy breaking down moderately complex problems into manageable components. * You take ownership of your work and follow assignments through to completion. * You seek feedback and use it to improve your technical skills and deliverables. * You communicate clearly and are developing the ability to tailor communication for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * You are reliable, productive, and committed to delivering quality work on time. * You build productive relationships with teammates and internal stakeholders. * You act with honesty and transparency in your technical work, communication, and interactions. * You're excited to learn industry\-specific tools, libraries, operating systems, and software engineering best practices. * You have a passion for the exploration, development, and settlement of space. **Bonus Points if You Have Experience With** * Aerospace or space industry experience * Ground or flight software development * Additional software development languages or tools * Experience working with industry software engineering tools and best practices * Experience developing software for mission\-critical systems * Experience working in a collaborative engineering environment **Success is Measured By** * Delivering reliable, high\-quality C\+\+ and Python code. * Successfully completing assigned software development tasks on time. * Writing modular and testable software. * Consistently running and addressing unit and regression tests. * Breaking down technical problems and developing effective solutions. * Applying feedback to continuously improve technical skills and software quality. * Taking ownership of assignments from start to completion. * Communicating proactively when estimates or deliverables are at risk. * Building strong working relationships with teammates and internal stakeholders. * Contributing to process improvements and the overall technical capabilities of the team. **Why Join Advanced Space** * Work on real missions that are shaping the future of lunar and deep\-space exploration. * Develop software that supports actual space missions and flight operations. * Collaborate with experienced engineers across software, mission design, navigation, and other technical disciplines. * Be part of a growing company where your technical contributions have a direct impact on mission success. * Grow your software engineering skills while working on challenging problems in the space industry. * Join a team that's passionate about delivering innovation to orbit and beyond. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Salary: **$80,000–$105,000** (based on experience, qualifications, and location) * Signing bonus * Quarterly performance bonuses * Company\-sponsored medical benefits and 401(k) * Flexible time off * Relocation assistance * **Hybrid work schedule** (minimum three days per week onsite) for employees within jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Laravel, Node.js)
jobs.description: **On\-site in Gurnee, IL. You must already live within commuting distance.** This role is based in our office at 1800 Nations Drive in Gurnee, Illinois, about four days a week, with flexible work\-from\-home when you need it. You must already live within commuting distance: Lake County, the north Chicago suburbs or the Kenosha area. All interviews are in person. We cannot consider remote\-only applicants, and we do not sponsor visas. **Pay:** $75,000 to $100,000 per year, full\-time **Benefits:** health insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, company\-paid AI development tools and training, flexible schedule **Build the engine behind websites that sell hypercars.** All Auto Network designs, builds and markets websites for exotic, luxury and classic car dealers selling Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Rolls\-Royce, Aston Martin, Rimac, Zenvo and Spyker, and more. We work with hundreds of dealerships, including some of the largest exotic dealer groups in the country. Clients see the websites. Underneath is a platform we built ourselves: * inventory feeds that move thousands of vehicles and photos every day and syndicate them to third\-party marketplaces * lead routing into dealer CRMs, including location\-aware routing for multi\-location dealer groups * vehicle\-acquisition programs that help dealers buy cars directly from the public * integrations with dozens of automotive vendors * the internal admin, billing and reporting tools our whole company runs on On our sites, a vehicle page is never just a page. It's wired to live inventory data, photos, search rankings, ad campaigns, lead routing and the dealer's CRM. That's the system you'll own. And there's always something custom on the bench. Recent examples: * a specialty auction platform * an acquisition program expanding from classic cars into exotics, motorcycles and boats * an outside website moving onto our platform without losing the search rankings it has earned **What makes this role different** We're not hiring someone to close tickets on one slice of a giant codebase. We want a builder. You'll design new systems, keep proven ones running, and decide where the platform goes next. Most developers only get to do one of those. Here you'll do all three. You'll own real production systems from start to finish: architect, build, test, ship and support. The people who depend on your work are down the hall in support, accounting, operations and project management. When you ship a tool on Tuesday, you'll watch someone use it Wednesday morning. **Keep it running. Make it better. Decide what's next.** Our stack is Laravel and PHP at the core, Node.js services alongside it, React and Next.js for a growing set of tools and front ends, MySQL, and Linux. Some of that PHP has been running dealer sites reliably for years. Running a platform like that well means three things: * **Keep it running.** Understand why the existing code works before you change it, and keep it reliable for the people who depend on it every day. * **Make it better.** Spot where it's holding the business back, and fix it in deliberate steps. Don't rewrite things just to follow a trend, and don't let anything rot. * **Decide what's next.** Turn what you learn into upgrade plans covering the approach, the tradeoffs, the risks and the rollout. Then present them to leadership and lead the work once they're approved. Your voice will shape our architecture. Senior leadership and our systems administrator are your partners on infrastructure and the biggest bets. Bring them a well\-reasoned plan and they'll back you. **What you'll own** * The design and build of new systems, services and integrations, from first sketch to production * Our in\-house Laravel and PHP applications: admin tools, reports, billing workflows and dealer back offices * Node.js services and tools, plus front ends built in React, Next.js and whatever framework fits the job best * Inventory feeds that import, normalize and distribute vehicle data and images over XML, JSON, CSV, FTP/SFTP and APIs * Lead forms, CRM delivery, spam protection and role\-based access * MySQL schema design, migrations, data quality and query performance * Production health on Linux: logs, processes, workers and service status * Safe releases: staging, deployment, monitoring and rollback * The modernization roadmap: what to upgrade, in what order, and why * Daily work in Claude Code and Cursor (we pay for them), with every change reviewed and tested before it ships **A week in the role** * **Monday:** a dealer's inventory feed starts sending malformed data. You trace it from the vendor's file through parsing and into the database, and the cars are back on the site by lunch. * **Tuesday:** a price\-history job takes over a minute to run. You rework the queries and get it down to a couple of seconds. * **Wednesday:** you sketch the architecture for a new multi\-location inventory feature. You weigh the data model, how it touches exi lan you won't need. **Where it leads** We're a small company that does big things, and we don't pigeonhole people. Your influence over the platform grows as fast as your judgment proves out. Developers here have grown into technical leadership, systems administration, data and automation, and marketing technology. You choose the direction, and our senior team helps you get there. **What you bring** * 4\+ years of full stack development, with deep PHP at the core, including serious work in mature code you didn't write * **Proof that you can build systems, not just features.** You've designed something real and shipped it, and you've lived with your decisions in production. * **Sound judgment across tradeoffs.** Before choosing an approach, you weigh performance, reliability, cost, security, maintainability and the people who'll use it. * **The ability to sell a plan.** You can explain a technical direction to non\-technical leadership in plain terms, with its risks and payoff. * Strong Laravel: architecture, queues and workers, console commands, migrations, configuration and deployments * Modern JavaScript: real Node.js experience, React or Next.js on the front end, and the range to pick up whatever framework a project calls for * Strong MySQL, including schema design and performance tuning * API and data\-integration experience: JSON, XML, CSV, FTP/SFTP, webhooks and scheduled imports * Comfort on the Linux command line, plus disciplined habits around version control, staging, backups and rollback **Bonus points** * You've led a legacy modernization or platform migration from plan to finish * Inventory, e\-commerce, CRM or data\-feed experience * Building internal admin, reporting or operations tools * Adding automated tests to systems that relied on manual testing * Daily AI\-assisted development, with the judgment to spot when the output is wrong You don't need to know cars. We'll teach you the automotive side. **How we work** * Practical over flashy. We want technology that's useful and understandable to the people who rely on it, not technology for its own sake. * We don't hand clients a template and walk away. We build, listen and refine until it actually fits how their business runs. * A small team doing big work, with no layers of bureaucracy. Designers, developers, systems, marketing and support all work on the same problems, and good work gets noticed. * On\-site in Gurnee about four days a week, with flexible work\-from\-home when life calls for it. Beyond that, we care about ownership and results, not rigid hours. **How we hire** We want proof, not buzzwords. Our process shows us how you build, how you think, and how you'd make the case for a change. * **Phone call:** a short conversation about your experience and the systems you've built. * **Walkthrough, in person in Gurnee:** bring something you designed and built, and take us through the architecture, the decisions behind it, and what you'd do differently now. * **Practical exercise:** we hand you a small legacy system. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon Ads, we're re\-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent\-builder SDK with pre\-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully\-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi\-step reasoning and multi\-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long\-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions. You will own the architecture of Tier\-1 services that handle millions of requests per day while holding millisecond latencies and strict SLAs. You will set the technical direction for distributed, service\-oriented platforms powering the next generation of AI\-driven advertising, and make the build\-versus\-buy and foundational technology choices that the team and its partner teams build on for years. Our systems and algorithms operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks. In this role, you will design new and re\-architect existing solutions for the fast\-growing scale of agentic infrastructure — including stateful runtime services and pre\-built platform components that agent\-builder teams rely on to ship production agents. You will not merely go through the full software development cycle but more importantly drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of AI\-powered advertising at Amazon. We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun\-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business. A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation. Key job responsibilities Senior SDEs are technical leaders for their team and beyond. You take large, ambiguous problems that span multiple systems and teams and break them into designs other engineers can execute. You own the architecture of the team's most critical services and are accountable for their correctness, scalability, latency, and operational health over the long term. You drive the technology choices that matter \- data and storage models, enforcement\-path latency budgets, and the seams between the orchestration runtime, knowledge base, and governance layers and you document the trade\-offs so decisions outlast any one project. You raise the quality bar across the team through design and code review, and you make hard calls on where to invest, what to simplify, and what to deprecate. You multiply the team's output: you mentor SDE\-1s and SDE\-2s, grow their design judgment, and set engineering standards that keep the platform maintainable as it grows. You identify systemic risks before they become incidents, drive root\-cause fixes that eliminate whole classes of failure, and partner across Ads org boundaries to align contracts and roadmaps. You influence the team's technical roadmap, represent the team in cross\-team and cross\-org technical forums, and translate research from Applied Scientists into production\-ready services. About the team Agent Fabric is Amazon Ads' AI infrastructure platform. We extend AWS AgentCore with advertising\-specific capabilities and a managed, stateful runtime, cutting agent development from months to weeks. We own the platform end\-to\-end: the agent\-builder SDK, the runtime that executes agents in production, and the knowledge and governance layers that keep it safe and accountable at scale. Our systems are in the critical path for GenAI projects across Amazon Advertising. Stateful Runtime \& Orchestration: an orchestration framework that turns a single agent turn into durable, resumable work: async conversations that persist after a turn ends and notify on completion, scheduled and event\-driven workflows, and multi\-step DAG execution with fan\-out, cancellation, and retry. Checkpointing, task queues, and short\- and long\-term memory let agents resume and learn across sessions. Knowledge Base: the RAG Knowledge Base that grounds advertiser answers across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP, reporting, and optimization. We run the KB agent, an OpenSearch vector index, and a daily ingestion pipeline spanning published and partner\-curated content, with eval gates that enforce retrieval quality before every rebuild. Pre\-Built Ads Components: delegated advertiser authorization, privacy\-safe logging, policy guardrails, real\-time data access, and context handoff between agents. Metering \& Throttling: metering every invocation across model calls, tool calls, memory operations, and session time, then enforcing per\-user and per\-advertiser limits on a sub\-millisecond path to protect the platform from abuse. Operational Excellence: parallelization for low latency, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, end\-to\-end tracing, security isolation, cost attribution, and versioned deploys with rollback. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 6\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 6\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 6\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 6\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants. It runs on our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on\-screen awareness, and it is built with privacy from the ground up. We build the harness, the foundation that turns a model into an assistant that can act. This is a systems engineering role for people who understand how large language models behave. **Description** A model can't act on its own. The harness runs the agent loop, carries context and tools to the model, executes the tool calls it makes, and streams results back reliably. It spans models running on device and larger models in Private Cloud Compute. It handles everything from single\-turn requests to long multi\-step tasks that span apps, survive interruptions, and resume cleanly. We're looking for a strong systems engineer who is fluent in how LLMs behave. The work is real\-time and resource\-constrained: responses must start fast enough for a voice assistant to feel instant, under tight latency, memory, and power limits on everything from Mac and iPhone to Apple Watch. Failures rarely have a single cause. In a typical week you might track down why a streamed response stalls, make tool calls cancel cleanly when the user interrupts, or replay a failed request to tell whether the model, the context, or the runtime was at fault. Every change to the harness changes how the model behaves, so we measure our work with evals, not just tests. You'll join the team that owns the core runtime and work alongside senior engineers and researchers. You'll also partner closely with the modeling, tools, and context teams and with app and framework teams across Apple. You'll take features from design through production and grow your ownership of the system over time. jobs.description: Do you get more energy from the hardest problem in the room than the easiest one? Do you want a hand in shaping the CPUs that run quietly inside nearly every Apple product from the one your iPhone relies on to capture the perfect photo, to the one guarding your Apple Watch? The CPU Platform Architecture team exists to push the limits of power\-efficient CPU performance, and we hold ourselves to a standard most teams wouldn’t bother with. infrastructure. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug and reason across complex systems. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred jobs.title: Senior Mobile App Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll help power Beacon's mission by building the cross\-platform React Native apps that patients and clinicians use with our EEG headbands and other wearables. Your work will shape how people capture high\-fidelity data and how easily they move through clinical trials and at\-home diagnostics. This isn't just another app. You'll build tools that help unlock insights into neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders, with the potential to improve lives at scale. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, and we also have in\-person office hubs in Boston and New York. For this position we will consider candidates based anywhere in the US Eastern time zone. ### **What success looks like** As part of our small, mission\-driven Mobile Apps Team, you will: * Lead development of our React Native mobile applications across iOS and Android. * Design and implement UX workflows for clinical trial participants and at\-home diagnostic patients. * Own the user experience, performance, reliability, and observability of the apps and features you build, using feedback from real users across diverse use cases and environments. * Work with engineers on our native iOS and Android BLE device SDKs to integrate device capabilities cleanly into the app. * Partner with our Devices team, other Platform teams, and product designers to build user\-centric mobile capabilities deeply integrated with the rest of Beacon's product ecosystem. * Help shape the roadmap and technical direction of our mobile platform. In your first 3–6 months, you might: * Build a new in\-app feature to validate EEG signal quality before data capture. * Streamline onboarding for new patients and trial participants to make our devices easier to use than ever. * Deploy new features that help our Clinical Operations team track compliance. * Improve app performance, release reliability, and crash/telemetry visibility across our Expo\-based build pipeline. ### **What you will bring** You'll be a great fit if you have: * 8\+ years of experience in mobile development, including substantial experience shipping and maintaining production React Native apps on both iOS and Android. * Strong TypeScript skills and familiarity with our stack (React Native, Expo, GitHub). * Experience with app state management, offline\-first data handling, and app store release processes. * A product mindset: you care deeply about UX, edge cases, and performance. * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, async environment. Bonus points if you've: * Integrated BLE peripheral devices into iOS and/or Android applications, or worked with sensor integration or health data streams. * Written native code (Swift or Kotlin) or built native modules for React Native. * Worked with medical devices, EEG, or wearables. * Worked on apps for clinical trials, patients, or another regulated environment. * Contributed to open source mobile or React Native projects. The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $190,000\. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Secure AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** Are you looking for an opportunity to use your knowledge and technical skills to help organizations adopt artificial intelligence (AI) securely and responsibly. As a Secure AI Engineer, you'll combine your skills in AI engineering, cybersecurity, and offensive security to assess, harden, and improve AI\-enabled systems. You'll have the chance to build your skills and solve real\-world challenges in a fast\-paced, agile environment. We are looking for someone like you to work closely with clients to design secure AI architectures, evaluate AI system resilience, identify vulnerabilities, and implement mitigations that enable safe deployment of generative AI and autonomous AI capabilities. As a Secure AI Engineer on our team, you'll advise clients on the secure design, deployment, and governance of AI systems and generative AI applications. You'll conduct AI red team assessments against large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, AI agents, and multi\-agent workflows. You will identify and demonstrate AI\-specific attack vectors, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion, extraction, and other adversarial techniques. You will develop recommendations and technical mitigations to improve AI system security, resilience, and trustworthiness. You will build, test, and evaluate agentic AI systems using modern orchestration frameworks and assess their security posture, design security testing methodologies, automation, and tooling for AI applications throughout the development lifecycle, and adapt and extend open\-source AI frameworks, security tools, and evaluation platforms to meet client\-specific requirements. You'll stay current with emerging AI threats, vulnerabilities, research, and industry best practices in this fast\-paced world of AI. Join us. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Systems Engineer** Bright Silicon Technologies \| Pleasanton, CA \| Full time**About the Role** ================== Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) is developing precision optical systems around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a solid\-state beam\-steering technology. Our projects include OCTANE, a free\-space laser communications terminal that brings together optics, electronics, and controls to connect moving platforms. Reliable embedded software makes that hardware work as a system. We’re looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the low\-level and system software that connects these components together. This is a broad, hands\-on engineering role spanning firmware, embedded Linux, device interfaces, hardware bring\-up, system integration, and test. Because we are a small engineering team, the work can vary from writing real\-time firmware and device drivers to performing hardware bring\-up and characterization in the lab. You’ll work closely with electrical, controls, communications, photonics, and software engineers to move systems from early prototypes to dependable integrated hardware. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working across these boundaries, learning unfamiliar technologies when needed, and taking ownership of problems that do not always fit neatly within one engineering discipline.**What you’ll do** ================== * Develop and debug C and C\+\+ firmware and embedded software for device control, data acquisition, and communications. Carry your work from hardware bring\-up through integration and validation. * Work with electrical engineers to bring up new hardware and diagnose problems across electronics, firmware, and software. Use measurements and targeted experiments to understand timing, performance, and reliability. * Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, protocol analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation to measure system behavior and investigate timing, signal, performance, and reliability problems. * Partner with controls, integration, communications, and photonics engineers to deploy algorithms and connect subsystems on target hardware. Provide dependable device access, timing, telemetry, and diagnostic interfaces. * Lead design and code reviews, share knowledge, and support other engineers through implementation and debugging. Document decisions so the team can build on each other’s work. * Strengthen automated builds, hardware testing, and release practices. Make software configurations reproducible and failures easier to diagnose as systems move from the lab toward deployment. **What we’re looking for** ========================== * Strong C and C\+\+ development skills and experience delivering embedded software on physical hardware. You’ve taken responsibility for a subsystem through bring\-up, integration, and validation. * Experience with bare\-metal firmware, an RTOS, or embedded Linux. You understand how concurrency, interrupts, memory, and execution timing affect system behavior and can investigate performance problems. * Hands\-on hardware and software debugging experience. You can read schematics, work with device documentation, and use debuggers, oscilloscopes, or logic analyzers to trace a problem to its cause. * Experience implementing device interfaces and communications, such as SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet. You can reason about latency, throughput, synchronization, and failure handling across connected components. * A degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience working with processor–FPGA systems or developing software interfaces to FPGA\-based hardware. * Familiarity with FPGA RTL development for timing, control, data acquisition, or digital interfaces. * Experience with precision instruments, robotics, lidar, optical systems, or communications hardware. * Familiar with Python or other scripting languages for test automation and lab tools; familiarity with MATLAB\-based algorithm development and the work needed to deploy algorithms on embedded targets. * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, field diagnostics, or maintaining shared embedded components across multiple products. * Experience leading engineers deliver coordinated technical work through planning, interface definition, reviews, or mentoring. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At BST we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.**Why BST** =========== * Help shape the embedded software behind a new optical technology, with work spanning hardware bring\-up, system integration, and deployment. * Lead through hands\-on engineering and collaboration with experienced colleagues in software, electronics, controls, precision mechanisms, and optics. * Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer\-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work. **Company Overview** ==================== At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing. Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products. We offer competitive salaries and equity incentives, and we value effective engineering alongside long\-term work/life balance. Our benefits include:* Equity Incentive Plan * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with other voluntary benefits * 3% employer contribution to employee 401(k) * Development and career growth opportunities * Generous paid time off and paid company holidays lUavU6VUxj

Cboe web services are running 24x7, and web engineers are responsible for ensuring uptime and resilience for applications that support all Cboe markets. We use industry\-leading technologies like Python, Django, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS to build websites that handle millions of requests per day, providing high\-quality market data and real\-time access to Cboe exchanges for our customers and the investing public. We operate at the tip of the spear, maintaining the primary interface for command and control of Cboe markets worldwide. We are aggressive, yet agile. We care about user experience. The Senior Financial Reporting Product Analyst is responsible for leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives that advance Schwab’s enterprise equity compensation platform, with a particular focus on financial reporting capabilities and client outcomes. You would drive major product enhancements, large\-scale client initiatives, system/data migrations, and regulatory\-driven changes—operating with increasing autonomy, navigating ambiguity, and influencing multiple teams to deliver measurable business value. You will provide strong delivery leadership with hands\-on product management experience in financial reporting (e.g., ASC 718/IFRS 2\) and the ability to translate accounting and operational needs into scalable platform capabilities. **For internal candidates**, current experience owning or driving EquiView financial reporting outcomes is a significant advantage (domain knowledge, established partnerships, and understanding of our controls and client commitments). **For external candidates**, current experience owning or driving outcomes for the financial reporting module of an enterprise equity compensation platform, is a significant advantage. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Reporting, Client Services, and Compliance to align priorities, manage risk and dependencies, and ensure high\-quality delivery across EquiView initiatives. **What you’ll do** * **Leadership \& Execution** – Lead end\-to\-end delivery for complex, multi\-release initiatives across EquiView, including financial reporting enhancements and regulatory\- and business\-driven updates. Drive UAT strategy and execution (planning, coordination, communications, and sign\-off) and ensure operational readiness for launch. * Partner with product owners, analysts, engineers, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to define problems, clarify requirements, and deliver incrementally, while balancing near\-term commitments with longer\-term platform strategy. * **Client \& Partner Focus** – Partner with business stakeholders to define clear acceptance criteria, refine backlog items, and ensure requirements are testable and executable. Work directly with Engineering and QA to support solution design, clarify functional behavior, and resolve complex platform issues. Collaborate with Reporting, Client Services, Conversion, Product Support, and Operations to support client readiness, training, and post\-launch adoption. * **Strategy** – Contribute to the product vision and roadmap for EquiView financial reporting and recordkeeping capabilities by combining market/regulatory awareness with internal stakeholder insights. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve scalability for clients and internal teams. * **Outcomes** – Define success measures (quality, timeliness, adoption, and risk reduction) and drive delivery from discovery through launch. Ensure solutions are well\-documented, supportable, and aligned to client needs and Schwab operational controls. **What you have** ----------------- To ensure that we fulfill our promise of "challenging the status quo," this role has specific qualifications that successful candidates should equirements, including Section 16 reporting, Forms 3, 4, and 5, 10\-K and 10\-Q disclosures, proxy reporting, and other equity\-related regulatory filings. * Strong knowledge of Employee Stock Purchase Plans, including ESPP accounting, administration, plan design, taxation, and employee reporting. * Experience working with equity plan platforms and enterprise financial reporting solutions, such as EquiView, Equity Edge Online, Shareworks, Fidelity PSW, and Certent/Global Shares. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex issues involving equity data, accounting calculations, reconciliations, business processes, and technology. * High attention to detail and the ability to drive work from initial concept through testing, implementation, operational readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization. * Demonstrated ability to deliver predictably, identify and manage risks proactively, and communicate clearly with business partners, technology teams, clients, and other stakeholders. * Ability and desire to work effectively and efficiently in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional team environment. * Experience participating in cross\-functional initiatives involving systems implementations, technology enhancements, financial reporting, operational process improvements, regulatory compliance, and business process redesign. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Software Engineer II** Collective Data is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help shape our fleet, asset, and quartermaster management platform. Our applications are configuration\-driven: business objects, views, reports, and workflows are defined in metadata and run by a C\+\+/Qt server and an Angular web client. The role is hands\-on development across that stack, plus two areas of growing importance: building AI\-powered product features, and building the AI\-assisted development workflows our engineering team uses every day. The ideal candidate has strong product judgment and can look beneath the user experience to judge how software is built. They treat AI as both a product capability and an engineering tool. They understand how models behave, where they fail, and how to build systems that stay correct when they do. They remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of every change, regardless of who or what wrote it. **Key Responsibilities:** **Product Development and Judgement** * Turn customer workflows into intuitive, reliable functionality, finding requirement gaps and edge cases before development begins. * Balance immediate customer needs against product consistency and technical sustainability. * Own features from technical design through implementation, testing, release, and follow\-up. **Platform Development and Code Quality** * Develop and maintain functionality across the C\+\+/Qt server, the Angular web client, and the SQL layer that generates queries for PostgreSQL and SQL Server. * Extend the metadata\-driven application platform: the definition types, the engines that interpret them, and the authoring tools used to build applications on it. * Migrate legacy UI to Angular without changing its existing behavior. * Refactor incrementally to improve separation of responsibilities, error handling, and testability. * Do substantive code reviews covering correctness, design, performance, and security. **AI\-powered Product Features** * Design and build LLM\-backed features such as natural\-language querying, AI\-assisted record creation, and AI review of application definitions. * Design prompts and model context, define structured\-output contracts, and validate model responses before they affect customer data. * Build evaluation methods that catch answers that are wrong but look plausible, not only outright failures, and use them to tune prompts and instructions. * Choose and route between models based on cost, latency, and quality, and log AI interactions so problems can be diagnosed. * Design human review gates for AI\-proposed changes to customer data and configuration. **AI\-assisted Development Workflow** * Build and maintain the team's AI development tooling: agent skills, plugins, and automated workflows for starting work, implementation, self\-review, preparing PRs, and review retrospectives. * Build our architecture standards and code\-review lessons into that tooling so recurring mistakes are caught automatically. * Measure whether workflow changes actually improve quality and throughout and retire the ones that don't. * Critically evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, architectural fit, security, and maintainability. Verify it rather than accept it. * Follow company requirements for protecting source code, credentials, and customer information when using AI tools. **Technical Ownership and Reliability** * Independently investigate complex defects, including crashes, memory errors, and concurrency issues in the server, and find their root causes. * Assess the scope and risk of changes, including their effect on customer configurations and data. Design tests, data migrations, and rollback plans to match. * Enforce authorization and access\-control rules on the server and treat client\-supplied input as untrusted. * Fix performance problems across server logic, generated queries, and the UI. * Document significant design decisions and mentor other developers. **Required Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of professional software development, including ownership of production software and complex changes. * Strong C\+\+ skills: object\-oriented design, memory and resource management, debugging, and performance analysis. * Strong Angular and TypeScript skills, including RxJS and signals. * Strong SQL skills: relational modeling, query semantics and optimization, transactions, and schema changes. * Experience building configurable business software, where application behavior comes from metadata or configuration rather than code. * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features to production: prompt and context design, structured outputs and tool use, evaluation, and failure handling. * Deep hands\-on experience with agentic AI coding tools, including customizing them with skills, rules, or automated workflows, not just prompting them. * Working understanding of LLM limitations (context limits, nondeterminism, hallucination, prompt injection) and how to design around them. * Ability to understand an established codebase and tell sound design from fragile implementation. * Experience with code review, automated testing, version control, and production troubleshooting. * Clear communication of tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical colleagues. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Qt. * SQL Server in addition to PostgreSQL. * Building developer tooling or internal platforms used by other engineers. * Fleet, asset, maintenance, inventory, or quartermaster management systems. * Supporting government or other organizations with demanding reliability and security requirements. * Azure\-hosted applications and Azure DevOps. **What Success Looks Like:** * Product improvements are intuitive, consistent, and match how customers actually work. * Complex changes ship with appropriate testing and a clear understanding of their risks. * AI features either give correct answers or fail visibly. The rate of wrong\-but\-plausible answers is measured and going down. * The team's AI workflow catches problems before human review, and the same review comments stop recurring. * Code becomes easier to understand, maintain, and extend. * Other developers benefit from thoughtful reviews, clear guidance, and better tooling. **Who is Collective Data?** Collective Data is a leading provider of Fleet Management and Asset Management software for both the public and private sectors. Our mission is to empower organizations with intelligent software solutions that help streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. **Why Join Us?** At Collective Data, we value innovation, collaboration, and the personal growth of our employees. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible work arrangements, and an environment where your input is valued and encouraged. Interested in making a difference with Collective Data? Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@collectivedata.com *Collective Data is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * AD\&D insurance * Bereavement leave * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible spending account * Free parking * Health insurance * Life insurance * On\-site gym * Paid parental leave * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance * Volunteer time off Application Question(s): * Are you willing and able to work in the office 5 days a week? * Explain how you’ve used AI assisted development in your day\-to\-day work. Work Location: In person

Must not only to dive deep into diﬃcult technical problems, but bring others along for the ride as well. * 7\+ years experience in some combination of software/hardware/systems engineering or leadership in technical operations. * Experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale orchestration systems. * Experience working with major internet protocols and standards (DNS, Whois, RDAP, etc.) * Experience with and passion for working in the internet security space. * Experience stepping across organizational boundaries to solve problems. * Strong understanding of architectural trade\-oﬀs at diﬀerent orders of magnitude of scale. * Strong technologist, broadly conversant in modern approaches to software engineering, systems engineering, operations, and infrastructure management. * Able to articulate and defend designs from architectural first\-principals * Able to adapt those designs to the realities of a complex business. * Strong desire to solve seemingly insurmountable technological and organizational problems. **Compensation:** $180K \- $230K base salary, plus a 15% annual bonus **Benefits** DomainTools is the global leader for Internet intelligence and the first place security practitioners go when they need to know. DomainTools constantly monitors the Internet and brings together the most comprehensive and trusted domain website and DNS data to provide immediate context and machine\-learning driven risk analytics delivered in near real\-time. DomainTools offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees that includes fully paid medical, dental and vision insurance premiums, a 401k retirement plan with company matching, basic life insurance, flexible PTO and additional well\-being benefits. jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Position Summary** The Senior QA Automation Engineer leads the quality strategy for the Evolent Platform web user experience. This role designs and maintains end\-to\-end, component, accessibility, contract, and test automation for a React and Next.js application and owns the quality signals that determine release readiness. This individual works independently with minimal supervision, applies creativity to testing challenges, sets and upholds the automation patterns others follow, and mentors quality engineers across the team. The role is expected to use approved AI\-assisted tools to accelerate testing and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Expectations** Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI\-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on test strategy and solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities** **Quality Strategy and Leadership** * Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive test strategies for the user experience, covering functional, regression, accessibility, performance, and AI\-output quality. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and product planning to ensure quality is built into all phases of the software lifecycle. * Define and uphold test automation patterns and standards in partnership with testing automation architects and front\-end leads. * Mentor quality engineers, promoting best practices in testing, automation, and quality assurance. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives in testing processes, tools, and methodologies, and evaluate emerging testing technologies for applicability. **Test Automation and CI/CD** * Lead the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Playwright end\-to\-end suites and Vitest component tests for React and Next.js features. * Build contract tests for the AG\-UI event stream, verifying event sequencing, shared state, tool\-call events, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval interrupts. * Build API tests for backend\-for\-frontend endpoints and .NET and Python (FastAPI) services. * Test streaming behavior and resilience, including slow, interrupted, and failed agent calls, retries, and timeouts. * Plan and execute basic load and performance tests for streaming endpoints and data\-heavy screens. * Integrate and execute automated suites in GitHub Actions, maintaining a consistently high pass rate and reliable results. **Accessibility Testing** * Lead accessibility testing against WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508, combining automated axe\-core checks with manual screen reader testing using JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver. * Partner with engineering and design to triage accessibility defects and support independent accessibility conformance reviews. **Defect Management and Quality Reporting** * Isolate, analyze, document, and prioritize defects before escalating to developers, and collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders for timely resolution. * Analyze test and evaluation results, generate quality metrics, and report on quality state and release readiness to stakeholders. * Present work in Agile ceremonies and lead technical knowledge\-sharing sessions. **AI\-Enabled Quality Engineering** * Utilize approved AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, test script development, test data generation, documentation, troubleshooting, and defect analysis. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated tests, scripts, and analysis for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness. * Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing productivity and solu ed, or protected information (including PHI in test data) is used with unapproved AI services or tooling; use synthetic data for testing. * Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI\-assisted solutions. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including 3\+ years of hands\-on test automation for modern web applications. * Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript or JavaScript for end\-to\-end automation. * Experience with component testing using Vitest or Jest and React Testing Library. * Experience testing React\-based web applications, including asynchronous and streaming behavior. * Hands\-on accessibility testing experience with axe\-core and manual screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) against WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508\. * Experience with API testing and contract testing, including schema\-based validation of APIs or event streams. * Experience with load or performance testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter). * Experience creating and maintaining automation jobs in CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions with YAML) and version control with Git. * Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM). * In\-depth knowledge of testing methodologies, including functional, regression, accessibility, and performance testing. * Experience working in Agile development environments. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting and issue resolution. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor others. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience evaluating AI or LLM output using test datasets, scoring rubrics, or evaluation frameworks. * Familiarity with AG\-UI, CopilotKit, the Vercel AI SDK, or other streaming (SSE) agent interfaces. * Experience with Python for test tooling or agent evaluation. * Experience using AI\-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or Playwright MCP. * Experience with FHIR R4 test data; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus. * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry for diagnosing test failures. * Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments handling PHI. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $115,000\- 120,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Advanced Process Control (APC) Engineer
jobs.description: Your Job The Advanced Process Control (APC) Engineer will evaluate, prioritize, and capture sustainable value from multiple APC and Real\-Time Optimization (RTO) opportunities for the Pine Bend Refinery. They will learn to transform our APC Engineering capabilities from a technical service into a cross\-unit optimization and controls capability, and explore new or emerging technologies that advance Pine Bend's competitive advantage. The successful candidate will possess the knowledge and skills necessary to support APC and RTO software solutions and model development to better improve overall system availability, performance, and reliability. The successful candidate will have the drive and passion to collaborate with operations and optimization to prioritize multiple, simultaneous, high\-profile business requests and aggressively pursue the highest\-value alternatives while building and maintaining strong relationships with our key operations, engineering, and management stakeholders. Our Team Our team consists of APC engineers and AI process control engineers, with a mix of technical experts and developing talent, that provide the modeling and control expertise necessary to turn optimization strategies into control solutions. APC Engineers collaborate with other members of the PC Capability in small tactical teams, including a System Optimization Engineer, 6th Process Lead, DCS Engineer, and members of one or several Business Teams to develop and implement the daily oil flow strategies and optimization priorities every day. What You Will Do * Partner with teams of optimization engineers, operations experts, process engineers, process control engineers, and/or vendor consultants for model prioritization and development. * Prioritize, design, develop, build, test, commission, and document APC applications using DMC3 and other tools in support of optimization objectives for an area of the refinery. * Provide insights and short\-term support for system optimization and oil flow planning in collaboration with operations and optimization team members. * Work with vendors and internal experts to advocate for emerging technologies (i.e. artificial intelligence for process control) to advance Pine Bend's competitive position. * Manage relationships with our operations partners to provide maximum benefit in support of the refinery's operational profitability vision. * Educate other refinery personnel on APC benefits and multi\-variable control design, provide support and troubleshooting of process control problems for APC and RTO applications, and implement recommendations for improvements that often originate from the customer. * Develop and maintain lines of communication with board operators, engineers, and managers with the intent of sustaining high model utilization against an optimized constraint set. * Communicate effectively the value captured, opportunity lost, and control system health in each process area under study. * Demonstrate critical and economic thinking skills through strong written and confident verbal communication. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) * Bachelor's degree in engineering OR a minimum of ten (10\) years of work experience with process control systems. * Five (5\) years or more of work experience as a process or controls engineer. * Experience communicating effectively with various levels of an organization (engineers, managers, operators, team leaders, contractors). What Will Put You Ahead * Ten (10\) years or more of advanced process control or process engineering work experience in refining or petrochemicals. * Experience with refinery economics, constraints, and oil flow planning. * Experience with process modeling and/or advanced process control fundamentals. * Experience with AspenTech's suite of APC software tools and familiarity with RTO applications. * Experience with troubleshooting and resolving process control strategies and problems. * Experience designing, implementing, and tuning advanced control applications. This role is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship. For this role, we anticipate paying $120,000 \- $180,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. Hiring Philosophy All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here. Who We Are As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry\-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000\+ miles of pipeline \- delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Our team champions innovation and excellence to help power modern life. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Our Benefits Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. Equal Opportunities Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID 72609 Category Enterprise Technology Location Dearborn, Michigan Work Type Hybrid **In this position....** Ford's connected vehicles send us a constant stream of data: trips, alerts, battery and health signals, and much more. The Connected Vehicle Data Team in GDIA (Global Data Insight \& Analytics) builds the services, APIs and applications that make that data easy to find, understand, and use across Ford. We're looking for an early\- to mid\-career full\-stack software engineer who likes building things end to end: backend services in Java and Spring Boot, frontends in React or Angular, and the cloud deployments and data flows that connect them. You'll deploy to OpenShift and Google Cloud, learn how streaming data behaves at very large scale, and see your work used to spot vehicle issues sooner. You don't need to have done everything on this page. We care more that you're curious, careful with details, and eager to learn. That's what the Ford OS Behaviors are about: be a builder, play to win, and deliver the promise. **What you’ll do….** * **Backend services and APIs.** Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices in Java and Spring Boot, backed by SQL databases and BigQuery. * **Frontend apps and dashboards.** Build features and reusable components in React or Angular with TypeScript that help people explore vehicle data. * **Streaming integrations.** Write Kafka and Pub/Sub producers and consumers, and learn how to handle retries, failed messages, and message order. * **Cloud deployments.** Package apps with Docker and deploy them to OpenShift and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE), including configuration, secrets, and health checks. * **Testing and quality.** Write unit and integration tests with JUnit and frontend test tools (for example, Jest or Cypress), take part in code reviews and pairing, and learn test\-driven development. * **Monitoring and support.** Add logging, alerts, and dashboards in Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring, and help troubleshoot production issues using runbooks. * **Good engineering habits.** Use Git and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Tekton), keep dependencies up to date, fix issues found by code quality and security scans, and follow secure coding, API security, and data privacy practices. * **AI in practice.** Use tools like GitHub Copilot every day for code, tests, and documentation. You'll also help with the team's AI work, for example: + building the API and UI for an assistant that answers plain\-English questions about vehicle data + calling LLM APIs to draft metadata, summaries, or release notes + trying simple ways for an AI assistant to answer questions from team documentation + writing test cases that check AI output is accurate and safe * **Working as a team.** Work with senior engineers, the team's technical lead (Anchor), product owners, data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them. data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them. **You’ll have…** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. * 1 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong internships or co\-ops count. * Hands\-on experience building backend services or REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Day\-to\-day use of Git, and experience writing automated tests (for example, JUnit). * A basic understanding of Docker and deploying applications to a cloud or container platform. * The habit of asking "how will I know this works?" and testing before you ship. **Even better, you may have….** * GCP experience, especially Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, or Cloud Storage. * Kafka or Pub/Sub, or concepts such as retries, dead\-letter queues, and message ordering. * OpenShift or Kubernetes (deployments, config maps, secrets, health checks). * CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Tekton, or Jenkins, code scanning tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, or FOSSA, and some Terraform. * Monitoring with Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Splunk, and setting reliability targets (SLOs). * Agile practices such as Scrum, XP, test\-driven development, or pair programming. * Hands\-on work with AI, such as calling an LLM API, building a small RAG app, or an agent. School, hackathon, and personal projects all count. * Python for scripting or data work. * Experience with IoT, telemetry, or other time\-series data. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. **This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $85,400\-$143,200\.** **This position is a salary grade 7 and ranges from $99,600\-$166,600\.** Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Embedded)
jobs.description: Forj Medical designs and develops custom electromechanical devices driven by safety\-critical embedded software. We work in 4 major Technology Segments: Fluid \& Gas Management, Optical Systems, Surgical Energy and Stimulation/Active Wearables. Our projects typically involve ‘greenfield’, bespoke designs \- giving our engineers both depth and breadth in design challenges – opportunities to learn \& grow abound. What you’ll do As a Principal Software Engineer at Forj, you’ll be one of our most trusted technical leaders—helping teams turn our clients’ most difficult medical\-device challenges into safe, secure, and maintainable embedded software. You’ll combine deep hands\-on engineering with broad influence: shaping product and platform architectures, guiding critical technical decisions, and raising the quality of software work across projects. You’ll work with significant autonomy, but not alone—partnering closely with clients, program leaders, and engineers across systems, electrical, mechanical, test \& quality. **Core responsibilities include:** * Applying expert knowledge of the Forj Quality Management System, FDA regulations, IEC 62304, and cybersecurity standards to software system development. * Proactively identifying the highest technical and program risks early; evaluating alternatives, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicating recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Leading requirements definition, architectural design, and technical decision\-making across software\-intensive medical device systems. * Providing detailed estimates in support of project milestones and software deliverables; delivering medium to highly complex software projects within scope, schedule, and budget constraints. * Applying a unique feature\-focused method of breaking down software system functionality; you'll iteratively lead your software team through architecture, design, implementation, testing and integration of software features in an agile workflow. * Leading and mentoring a team of software engineers through work planning, task delegation, and coordination of execution. * Design, implement and test project source code, especially in critical areas, including debugging difficult system issues, navigating integration challenges, and demonstrating effective engineering practices. * Owning the technical quality of all software artifacts – ensuring architectural integrity, code quality and design robustness. * Driving software process improvements, reusable platforms, and engineering initiatives that benefit multiple projects. * Serving as a trusted advisor to clients, engineering leadership, and cross\-functional teams on high\-impact technical decisions. You’ll have a chance to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients – our recent products help clinicians treat cancer, sustain life and alleviate pain. To top it off, we think you’ll enjoy working with other smart, curious and talented engineers as you bring medical devices to life. How we work Project teams are led by a Program Manager / Systems Engineer; technical leads from Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Test and Quality collaborate on projects for clients ranging from established companies to small startups. We foster a strong engineering culture and operate under mature software \& product development processes. We invest in tools, automation and continuous improvement. We work at an efficient, sustainable pace – taking time for fun along the way! **Working Conditions:** Must be authorized for permanent work in the United States. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Formlabs:** Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building tools that let anyone bring ideas to life, from cutting\-edge products to life\-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We're a team of hands\-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. **Your Impact:** Firmware turns a Formlabs printer from a box of boards, motors, lasers, and sensors into a machine people trust for a 12\-hour print. It runs on more than 130,000 printers in dental labs, hospitals, factories, and engineering teams, from the Form 4 and Form 4L to the Fuse 1\+ and Fuse X1\. As our **Embedded Engineering Manager**, you'll lead the embedded software team that writes it, across microcontrollers and embedded Linux. We're adding new printers over the next few years, so the platform you build now decides how fast each new machine comes up and how well it holds up in the field. **What You'll Do:** * Own delivery of embedded firmware for current and upcoming printers: hit program milestones, set the quality bar, and decide with program leads what ships now and what waits. * Stay hands\-on. Review architecture and code, debug on target hardware next to your engineers, and write code when the team needs another pair of hands. * Set direction for a shared embedded platform (drivers, communication stacks, RTOS and embedded Linux integration, bootloaders, firmware updates and build infrastructure) so each new printer reuses what works instead of starting over. * Hire strong embedded engineers, coach them toward their best work, and deal with performance problems directly and early. * Partner with electrical engineering, systems integration, mechanical and software teams from board bring\-up through production, and trace field failures back to root cause. * Build the test automation, CI, and static analysis that let the team ship firmware updates to a large installed base without breaking it. * Question requirements and cut work that doesn't matter to customers, so the team spends its time on what does. **About You:** * Experienced embedded software engineer who has shipped production firmware in C and C\+\+ for complex electromechanical products such as robots, consumer electronics, medical devices or industrial equipment. * You've led a team of embedded or firmware engineers, including hiring and managing performance. * You've taken multiple products from prototype to volume production and supported them after launch. * You're comfortable working from bare\-metal microcontrollers to embedded Linux and multicore processors, using Python for tooling and testing. * You've brought up boards and peripherals yourself (ADC, PWM, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet), can read a schematic, and debug with a scope and logic analyzer. * You can profile and optimize firmware for performance, memory, and power, and diagnose problems across several connected controllers using logs and trace data. * You make decisions with incomplete information, move quickly, and can explain how a technical call affects the customer. * You communicate clearly with electrical, mechanical, and software engineers, as well as product and program leads. **Bonus Skills:** * Linux kernel experience, such as writing device drivers * Firmware for motion control, lasers or optics, or thermal systems * Over\-the\-air (OTA) updates and device security for connected products * Supporting a large fleet of connected devices in the field * MISRA C or other safety\-critical coding standards * Passion and experience in 3D printing * Background in electronics or robotics **Our Benefits \& Perks:** * Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs * Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) * 401K matching and access to financial advisors * Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) * Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) * Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it * Ample on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats * Regular sponsored professional development opportunities * Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community * And of course… unlimited 3D prints *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* **Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.** Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.
