If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.

jobs.title: Sen. Full Stack Software Engineer/Tech Lead Position
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Roadrunner Health Services is seeking a senior full\-stack software engineer / technical lead to assume technical ownership of an existing custom electronic medical record (EMR) platform used for correctional healthcare workflows. The platform uses a Laravel/PHP backend, a Next.js/React frontend, MySQL, Git/Bitbucket, and AWS infrastructure. This is primarily a software takeover, rescue, hardening, and completion role\-not a greenfield rebuild. The successful candidate must be able to understand an existing codebase, preserve working clinical functionality, identify security and architectural deficiencies, and safely complete the platform for controlled production use. The role will work closely with executive leadership, clinical subject matter experts, operations, compliance, and external specialists as needed. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * No direct supervisory responsibility is required initially; however, this role is expected to provide technical leadership, code\-review standards, architecture guidance, and direction to contractors or additional developers when needed. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities:** * Assume technical ownership of an existing Laravel/PHP and Next.js/React codebase and establish a reliable development, staging, and production workflow. * Perform a structured takeover assessment of source code, Git history, database schema and migrations, dependencies, AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, credentials, integrations, testing, and technical documentation. * Develop, maintain, refactor, and complete existing clinical and operational workflows while avoiding unnecessary rewrites of working functionality. * Design and enforce secure authorization at the role, facility, resource, patient, and action level so users cannot access protected health information outside their authorized responsibilities. * Strengthen authentication, session security, least\-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, secure file handling, audit logging, and security monitoring. * Review and improve clinical record provenance, signatures, amendments, versioning, and auditability so historical clinical information is preserved appropriately. * Review MySQL schema design, Eloquent relationships, migrations, constraints, indexes, data integrity, and safe production database\-change practices. * Build and maintain automated unit, feature, API, integration, regression, and security\-focused tests around critical clinical workflows. * Maintain and improve AWS infrastructure, Linux/Nginx/PHP\-FPM configuration, deployment pipelines, backups, recovery procedures, monitoring, and documented restore testing. * Support existing integrations and data\-exchange workflows, including secure file transfer, external APIs, jail management system (JMS) data, reporting, and future interoperability interfaces. * Work with clinical and operational stakeholders to translate correctional\-health requirements into technically sound, testable product behavior. * Create and maintain architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, deployment/runbook documentation, API documentation, change records, and technical decision records. * Participate in vulnerability remediation, penetration\-test remediation, release readiness, user acceptance testing, and controlled pilot deployment. * Evaluate third\-party and open\-source dependencies for licensing, security, maintainability, and compatibility before adoption. * Perform other related software engineering and technical leadership duties as required. **Initial Priorities:** * Securely transition repositories, environments, credentials, deployment processes, and infrastructure control to Roadrunner Health Services. * Validate facility and patient\-level authorization boundaries and remediate object\-level access weaknesses before production use. * Validate database migrations and the ability to rebuild the application safely from source and documented configuration. * Harden audit/provenance controls, secrets handling, error handling, backups, restore procedures, and production deployment. * Establish sufficient automated testing and release gates for a controlled single\-facility pilot. **Required Technical Skills and Experience:** * PHP / Laravel: Advanced professional experience with modern PHP and Laravel, including Eloquent ORM, migrations, validation, policies/gates, middleware, events, queues, authentication, APIs, and testing. * React / Next.js: Strong experience maintaining production React and Next.js applications; TypeScript or strong modern JavaScript experience required. * MySQL / Relational Databases: Strong database design, query, indexing, migration, transaction, integrity, and performance skills. * Git / Bitbucket: Advanced Git skills including branching, merge/rebase workflows, code review, repository history analysis, release management, protected branches, and remediation of improperly committed secrets. * AWS: Hands\-on experience with EC2, EBS, IAM, VPC/s kflow requires stronger provenance, record locking, amendment history, authorization, auditability, or clinical safety controls. * Ability to work under a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and follow organizational policies governing PHI, credentials, source code, and production access. **Preferred Experience:** * Electronic health record (EHR/EMR), eMAR/medication administration, clinical documentation, healthcare reporting, or other clinical software experience. * Correctional healthcare, detention/jail systems, jail management system integrations, or other multi\-facility healthcare environments. * FHIR R4, US Core, USCDI, SMART on FHIR, HL7, terminology services, or healthcare interoperability standards. * ONC Health IT Certification, ASTP/ONC certification criteria, Inferno testing, or experience preparing software for formal health\-IT certification. * Medication, e\-prescribing, pharmacy, laboratory, Medicaid/X12, or other regulated healthcare integrations. * Figma or comparable design tools and the ability to work from existing design systems, prototypes, and implemented React components. Today, SDBB is continuing to grow to meet the changing needs of our healthcare community. San Diego Blood Bank is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization also operating as Southern California Blood Bank. jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **About the Team** Discovery Applications is the face of Scribd’s Machine Learning and Discovery Engineering Division. This role predominantly focuses on the frontend but comfort and knowledge of the full tech stack is a must as this role works closely with backend and ML engineers to build our complete product. thrives in a remote, documentation\-driven culture * Highly collaborative: partners closely with product, design, and backend to deliver end\-to\-end features **Nice to have** * Experience working with or migrating large, complex, or legacy frontend codebases * You’ve helped modernize frontend systems in production, not just greenfield projects * You think about frontend architecture as a product for other engineers, not just a delivery mechanism * You consider performa fe and repeatable * You enjoy untangling complexity and leaving systems better than you found them * You care deeply about how technical decisions affect both developers and end users \- At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $151,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $226,000 \[maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $124,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $214,000 \[maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $157,000 CAD\[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $201,000 CAD\[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Hybrid Work Model)
jobs.description: You’ll work closely with a team of engineers to develop, test, and maintain software applications, systems, or platforms. At Sentry, we’re more than just insurance—and we can offer you more than just a job. We want you to enjoy a career with us, where you’re in the driver’s seat of your career path with access to resources to help you succeed personally and professionally. As part of our Claims IT team or our Customer Communications IT team, you’ll play a crucial role in developing and enhancing custom solutions that support our operations, collaborating with skilled developers, engineers, quality analysts, and product analysts. You’ll be involved in the full software development lifecycle using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, C\#, Angular, SQL, and more in a hybrid cloud infrastructure. As part of our Commercial Lines Billing team, you’ll play a crucial role in developing and enhancing custom solutions that support our Billing operations, collaborating with skilled developers, engineers, quality analysts, and product analysts. You’ll be involved in the full software development lifecycle using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Java, Spring, Hibernate, Guidewire, SQL, and more in a hybrid cloud infrastructure. This position can be filled as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or Senior Software Engineer based on the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ You’ll be a valuable contributor to our team. As a Sentry associate, we believe in your skills and knowledge. Your input and participation matters. You’ll have the opportunity to: * **Innovate:** Through our agile development process, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your creativity and innovation to drive new solutions. * **Learn:** Sentry provides several resources to help you further your career and continue your personal development, including Sentry University, LinkedIn Learning, and peer\-led educational sessions and communities. * **Grow**: Sentry provides many opportunities to grow in your career. Through meaningful, ongoing conversations around growth and development, we encourage all associates to take ownership in their career path. * **Contribute:** You’ll work in a full\-stack, cloud\-first, development environment where you'll have the chance to work in many industry\-leading technologies. As a Software Developer, you will: + Complete assigned tasks on time while adhering to established software development practices. + Actively participate in team discussions and openly communicating status and effort. + Engage in the design, development, and implementation of new and existing programs or solutions. + Demonstrate ownership over the quality of assigned tasks, preparing test scripts and conducting tests on both new and existing solutions. + Actively engage in team delivery functions such as design reviews, code reviews, and scrum meetings. + Build an understanding of relevant business domains. Utilize growing understanding to enhance your work product. * **What it Takes:** + Associate Degree in Computer Science or related discipline; or equivalent related work experience. Bachelor Degree preferred. + Demonstrated aptitude in one or more programming languages and software development concepts. Proficiency in programming languages and tools relevant to the role preferred. + Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to optimize systems. + Demonstrated understanding of design principles and development best practices. + Ability to work independently and in a team environment. + Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills. If you have experience in the skills listed above, please consider joining our Sentry team! **What You’ll Receive** ----------------------- You can enjoy a complete benefits package, including generous paid time off, 8% 401(k) match, matching charitable gift program, bonus plan based on company performance, meal stipends, associate discounts, volunteer time off and more! You want a positive work/life balance. Our hybrid work model allows you to enjoy the benefits of working from home on Monday and Friday, but also provides the opportunity for team building and collaboration when working in the office on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. To help you work effectively and comfortably in both locations, we provide you with equipment to work at home and in the office. **About Sentry** ---------------- **Our Background**: We’re part of one of the largest and most financially secure mutual insurance groups in the nation. We’ve earned an A\+ rating from AM Best every year since 1992\. Our associates bring together diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets to make Sentry who we are. We’re honored to earn a spot on Forbes list of America's Best Midsize Employers, joining a select group of 400 companies. We’re in the business of helping others, and that includes the communities where we live and work. Our annual United Way campaign has raised more than $1 million for the past several years. **How You’ll Apply** -------------------- We’d love for you to join us. Please complete your online application and upload your resume on our Careers site. If you have applied with us before, you only need to provide your email address and password. If this is your first time applying with Sentry, please create an account. If you have specific questions regarding the position, application process, or are interested in learning more about Sentry, please reach out to Katelynne Rivera, Talent Acquisition Specialist Sr. **For this position, Sentry does not offer employment to holders of F\-1, J\-1, and H\-1 Visas.** Get ready to own your future at Sentry. Your opportunity awaits. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Sentry is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy that there be no discrimination in employment based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Financial Systems
jobs.description: Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce\-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4\.com. Shift4 is looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Financial Systems Experience team. This role will design, build, support, and improve critical applications, integrations, reporting workflows, and data\-driven tools used across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, Revenue Operations, and related business teams. This is a full stack engineering role with a heavy data engineering focus. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between front\-end application work, backend services, SQL, data pipelines, financial data models, and production support. They should be able to contribute directly to application development while also strengthening the reliability, accuracy, scalability, and auditability of the financial data flows that support billing, payments, fees, merchant reporting, month\-end close, and stakeholder self\-service. This person will also help provide technical partnership for front\-end development work, ensuring financial systems applications are maintainable, performant, secure, and aligned with business needs. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support full stack applications for Shift4’s Financial Systems team. * Build and maintain backend services, database logic, and integrations that support financial operations workflows. * Develop and optimize SQL, stored procedures, data pipelines, reporting datasets, and data validation routines for high\-volume financial data. * Partner with front\-end engineers to review application architecture, code quality, UI behavior, data contracts, and integration patterns. * Contribute to front\-end development. * Support systems and workflows related to billing, payments, and other internal financial platforms. * Diagnose and resolve production issues involving application behavior, data quality, integrations, performance, and financial output accuracy. * Build solutions that are scalable, secure, auditable, and maintainable in a financial systems environment. * Collaborate with business analysts, QA, TPMs, finance stakeholders, data teams, and other engineering groups to translate complex business requirements into reliable technical solutions. * Create clear technical documentation, including data models, process flows, integration logic, validation rules, and support notes. * Improve engineering standards around testing, code review, observability, deployment readiness, and data quality controls. * Identify opportunities to automate manual financial operations processes and reduce recurring support or reporting burden. * Use AI\-assisted development and automation tools responsibly to improve productivity, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation quality. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Experience with backend development in .NET, C\#, VB.NET, Java, Python, Node.js, or similar languages. * Strong SQL experience, preferably with Microsoft SQL Server, including stored procedures, query optimization, data validation, and troubleshooting. * Experience building or supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, reporting datasets, or large\-scale operational data workflows. * Experience developing or reviewing front\-end applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or similar technologies. * Understanding of SDLC practices, Git\-based development, code review, testing, deployment, and production support. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex application and data issues independently. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to finance, operations, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience writing clear documentation for code, data flows, system behavior, and operational support. * Ability to work in an agile environment and manage work across multiple business\-critical priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with financial systems, fintech, payments, billing, residuals, revenue operations, accounting operations, or ERP platforms. * Strong understanding of financial data quality, audit controls, compliance\-sensitive workflows, and reconciliation processes. * Experience modernizing legacy applications, SQL\-heavy systems, or manual finance operations workflows. * Experience supporting month\-end close, billing cycles, merchant reporting, pricing logic, fee configuration, or financial reporting. * Experience mentoring engineers or serving as a senior technical reviewer for application and data engineering work. * Experience with observability, logging, alerting, performance tuning, jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Devops
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who we are looking for** Slate is looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to set the technical direction for how we build, run and operate our infrastructure, and to build a large share of it yourself. We don't separate DevOps from SRE. The team that builds the platform also runs it, carries the pager, and is accountable for its reliability. Our AWS foundation is in place: a governed multi\-account environment, private connectivity between the cloud and our sites, and infrastructure as code throughout. Next is a hybrid Kubernetes platform that spans Amazon EKS and self\-managed clusters in our own facilities, serving our digital, data, manufacturing and enterprise teams. You will design that platform and help ship it. This is a hands\-on role. You'll lead through architecture, code and example rather than through direct reports, and you'll take your turn on call like everyone else on the team. You will report to the leader of the DevOps team and work closely with Digital, Data Engineering, IT, Manufacturing Systems and Security. * **The Hands\-On Architect:** You design systems and then build them. You're as comfortable writing a design doc as you are writing a CDK construct in Python or a Helm chart, and you can tell a platform people choose to use from one they are forced to use. * **The Reliability Owner:** You think in SLOs and failure modes. You've been paged at 2 a.m., you've written the postmortem, and you've made sure the same thing didn't page anyone again. * **The Hybrid Thinker:** You know when a workload belongs in the cloud and when it belongs next to the machines it talks to. You weigh latency, cost, data gravity and operational burden, and you can explain the trade\-off to people who don't work in infrastructure. * **The Force Multiplier:** You'd rather build a paved road than approve every request by hand. Other teams ship faster because of what you build and document. **What you get to do** * **Architect the Hybrid Kubernetes Platform:** Define and build Slate's Kubernetes ecosystem across Amazon EKS and self\-managed clusters running on virtualized infrastructure provided by our IT team. Own the reference architecture for cluster provisioning, multi\-cluster management (such as Rancher), networking, identity, secrets, storage and upgrades. * **Set the Direction for Our AWS Foundation:** Evolve our multi\-account AWS environment, including account governance and guardrails, identity and access management, and the networking and DNS that connect the cloud to our sites. Decide where new workloads live and how they connect. * **Build the Reliability Practice:** Establish our on\-call rotation, SLOs and error budgets, alerting standards, incident response and blameless postmortems. Stand up the observability (metrics, logs, traces and synthetic checks) that tells us something is wrong before our users do. * **Enable the Teams We Serve:** Partner with our Digital teams (customer\-facing website and backend services), Data Engineering, Manufacturing Systems and enterprise application teams. Give them well\-supported paths: CI/CD templates, deployment patterns, reusable infrastructure libraries and self\-service environments. * **Plan for What's Next:** Shape how the platform supports manufacturing and plant\-floor workloads, data pipelines, and emerging AI and agentic workloads, whether each one runs on\-premises or in the cloud. * **Build In Security and Cost Discipline:** Make least\-privilege access, policy guardrails, secrets management and software supply chain controls the default. Keep cloud spend visible and deliberate through tagging, right\-sizing and commitment planning. * **Ship and Mentor:** Write production infrastructure and code every week. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers on the team and across the organization, and write the documentation and runbooks that let others move without waiting on you. **What you bring to the team** * 10\+ years in DevOps, site reliability, platform or infrastructure engineering, including several years setting technical direction for production platforms. * **Deep AWS Expertise:** Extensive hands\-on experience designing and operating production AWS environments across many accounts, including multi\-account governance, identity and access management, VPC networking and hybrid connectivity, DNS, EKS, containers, serverless and managed data services. An AWS Professional or Specialty certification is a plus. * **Kubernetes in Production, in the Cloud and On\-Premises:** Proven experience running Kubernetes in production on EKS and on self\-managed clusters built on VMs or bare metal, including cluster management platform is a strong plus. * **Python and Infrastructure as Code:** Strong experience with infrastructure as code; AWS CDK is strongly preferred. Our platform code is written in Python, so strong Python skills are required. You can read, understand and make targeted changes to TypeScript, which some of our application teams use. * **CI/CD and GitOps:** Experience building delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions or similar tools, and deploying to Kubernetes with GitOps tooling (Argo CD or Flux), Helm and Kustomize. * **Reliability Engineering:** A track record of establishing SLOs, observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch or similar), incident management and on\-call practices, and of participating in on\-call yourself. * **Hybrid Networking:** A solid grasp of networking across cloud and on\-premises environments: routing, VPN, DNS, load balancing, certificates and firewalls, and how each of them fails. * **Technical Leadership Without Authority:** Ability to drive architectural decisions across teams you don't manage, write clear design documents, and bring skeptical stakeholders along. * **Startup Orientation:** Comfort in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment. You know how to ship, how to cut scope without cutting corners, and how to improve a system while it's running. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Nice to have** * Exposure to manufacturing, industrial or OT environments and the constraints of running software near the plant floor. * Experience running GPU, machine learning or AI and agentic workloads on Kubernetes. * Familiarity with enterprise virtualization platforms such as VMware. Policy as code (OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno), service mesh, or GitHub Enterprise administration. * **WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENT** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time. **SALARY RANGE** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. $155,854\.00 \- $233,781\.00 USD Annual **ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Experiences (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. Core Experiences owns the platform and front end behind Smartsheet's most used work surfaces. These are the sheets, reports, and dashboards millions of people open every day to plan, track, and run their work. Underneath them are petabytes of customer work data, one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. As AI agents join human teams, that data has to serve two very different users. People expect an instant, real\-time collaborative experience. Agents read, write, and analyze at machine scale. Meeting both means rethinking how sheet data is stored, served, and moved between our operational systems and a world\-class lakehouse platform. We hold that work to the highest standards of performance, reliability, and correctness. As a Principal Software Engineer on Core Views, you will set the technical direction for systems at the heart of Smartsheet. This is a hands\-on architect role. You will spot the company's largest technical opportunities before they are obvious, prove them out with prototypes, and build alignment across engineering organizations, including on roadmaps you do not own. You will turn multi\-quarter efforts into phased plans with clear milestones and candid risk reporting, then deliver them. You will make the hard trade\-offs between latency, consistency, and cost. You will write the architecture decisions and standards other teams build on, and raise the technical bar for engineers across the company. Your first major initiative will reshape how sheet data moves between our transactional stores and our data platform. What comes after is yours to help define. You will report to our Sr. Director of Engineering located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer. **You Will:** * **Architect the Sheet Data Platform:** Own the end\-to\-end design for how sheet data is stored, tiered, and served across our transactional databases and our lakehouse platform. That includes data lifecycle and retention strategy, schema evolution, asynchronous access patterns, and consistency guarantees that users and agents can rely on. * **Design for People and Agents at Scale:** Shape the services and APIs that serve sheet data to a real\-time collaborative experience used by millions and to AI agents that read, write, and analyze at machine scale. Make the hard trade\-offs between latency, consistency, and cost, and document them so others can build on them. * **See Around Corners:** Identify the largest technical opportunities and risks across Core Views and the platforms it depends on before they become obvious. Build the prototypes that prove them out and turn them into initiatives leadership will invest in. * **Lead High\-Stakes Migrations:** Plan and execute changes to petabyte\-scale production data with zero customer impact. That means phased cutovers, backfill and reconciliation, verification at scale, and a rollback path for every step. * **Own Delivery End to End:** Scope multi\-quarter efforts into phased plans with clear milestones, track progress across teams, raise risks early and candidly, and ship on time. * **Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries:** Partner with Product, Data Platform, AI Platform, and Infrastructure to align on direction. Influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent Core Views in company\-level platform and vendor decisions. * **Set the Standard:** Bring industry best practices into Smartsheet engineering. Write the architecture decisions, RFCs, and standards other teams build against, and lead the design reviews that hold them to that bar. * **Lead on AI\-Driven Engineering:** Define the patterns and guardrails for integrating AI capabilities into complex multi\-system architectures and into how our engineers build software. Measure the impact so successful practices spread across groups. * **Stay Hands\-On:** Solve complex problems across multiple systems with simple, high\-performing code in Java on AWS and Kubernetes. Do deep code reviews across product areas, and mentor senior and staff engineers on distributed systems and data\-intensive design. * **Own Production at the Deepest Level:** Participate in on\-call and lead the most complex incidents to resolution. Dig into the internals of databases and infrastructure to find performance bottlenecks, and drive the root\-cause work that makes the platform more resilient. **You Have:** * 10\+ years building highly scalable, highly available, low\-latency systems, including several years operating at Principal or Staff level. You write production\-quality Java or Kotlin and can work comfortably across the stack. * **Asynchronous Distributed Systems:** You've designed and run async, event\-driven systems on AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. You know firsthand where they break: ordering, idempotency, back\-pressure, partial failure, and consistency across service boundaries. * **Large Data in Production:** You've owned systems backed by very large relational or distributed datastores. You've tuned them, scaled them, outgrown them, and moved data off them without customers noticing. * **Ambitious Projects, Shipped:** You've taken a fuzzy, high\-stakes technical problem from first prototype to production across multiple teams. You can show the phased plan, the risks you called early, and the outcome. * **Direction Others Adopted:** You've written the design docs, RFCs, or standards that changed how an engineering organization builds, and they held up after you moved on. * **LLMs in Real Products:** You've built LLM\-enriched workflows that delivered measurable value to SaaS customers, and you have grounded opinions on what AI does and doesn't change about building software. * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience. * Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. **Nice to Have** * Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark) or comparable lakehouse experience such as Snowflake or Apache Iceberg. If you haven't used it but learn fast, we still want to hear from you. * Streaming platforms such as Kafka or Kinesis. * Building data access for AI agents, such as MCP servers or agent\-facing APIs. * Real\-time collaborative applications. **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. \#LI\-Remote

iterate designs based on test data and field feedback * Manage relationships with external vendors/suppliers on custom mechanical components and tooling * Balance cost, weight, and aesthetics – residential products need to look good on a garage wall, not just perform * Create and maintain technical documentation, design reviews, and change management records **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or related field); Master's a plus * 5\+ years of mechanical design experience, ideally in residential energy storage, EV, renewable energy, or related power electronics/hardware industries * Strong hands\-on experience with 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo, or similar) and FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, or similar) * Solid understanding of sheet metal, extrusions, weldments, castings, and enclosure design (IP/NEMA ratings) * Familiarity with LFP battery pack mechanical integration and thermal management concepts (passive/active cooling, thermal runaway mitigation and venting) as applied to battery or power electronics systems * Working knowledge of safety/compliance standards such as UL9540/9540A, UL 1973, NFPA 855, and relevant seismic design codes for residential installations * Experience taking products from prototype through DFM/DFA and into volume manufacturing * Good understanding of field installation constraints (wall\-mount, ground\-mount, conduit/wiring access, technician ergonomics) * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable with hands\-on prototyping and testing * Excellent cross\-functional communication and project management skills * Ability to visit external contract manufacturer, Vendors/suppliers sites as per business needs **Nice to Have** * Direct experience with UL 9540A thermal runaway propagation testing and fire mitigation design * Exposure to seismic, shock/vibration, or transportation (UN 38\.3\) qualification testing for Lithium batteries * Experience with GD\&T and formal tolerance analysis * Experience designing for installer/electrician workflows (NEC compliance considerations, conduit entry points, etc.) * Background working with contract manufacturers or overseas suppliers

behavior and risk: guardrails, hallucination controls, brand and tone consistency, and compliance sign\-off before agents go live or expand scope. * Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across both teams, partnering with support engineering, data science, and external AI partners on underlying orchestration and infrastructure. * Define, track, and report information architecture, and knowledge representation — or demonstrated success leading engineers who work in these areas. * Understanding of how machine learning pipelines consume structured knowledge, including retrieval\-augmented generation knowledge base iplines. * Experience in large\-scale enterprise technology companies with high\-volume technical support operations. * Experience standing up or scaling an AI agent evaluation and benchmarking practice covering accuracy, safety, and containment. * Familiarity with semantic web standards (SKOS, OWL, schema.org) and modern Amazon Bedrock, or comparable tooling. * Global or distributed team leadership experience and a track record of driving adoption of new processes and tools across multiple teams. * Thought leadership contributions — writing, speaking, or community involvement — in knowledge management, KCS, or AI\-enabled support practices. architecture, MCP integration, Codex/Claude Code configuration, prompt engineering, and context management. * Experience building multi\-agent research or customer support systems, or structured data extraction pipelines. * Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps in support of AI/agentic infrastructure. * Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and AI evaluation jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview Spectrix Analytical Services, LLC is a dedicated provider of on\-site analytical chemistry services, delivering reliable and high\-quality results since 1999\. Our team of experienced scientists supports research and development efforts across various industries by generating precise analytical data and maintaining sophisticated instrumentation directly at our clients' laboratories. Spectrix Analytical Services is seeking a ML Platform / Agentic AI Engineer. This contract role focuses on building and operating the compute platform, MLOps, and agentic tooling that support protein therapeutic design. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) remote position open to candidates in the United States or Canada. Working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern time are preferred; West Coast candidates who can overlap with Eastern business hours will also be considered. The contractor will work across a Kubernetes\-based workflow orchestration platform, a scientific tools monorepo of containerized computational biology applications, and the data and model infrastructure that connects them to downstream analytics in Snowflake. Depending on background, work will center on one or more of the areas below; we expect contractors to work across area boundaries as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Platform and workflow engineering.** Extend the Kubernetes orchestration platform and the workflows that run on it, including migrating existing application backends onto it. Make the platform region\-agnostic so compute can be scheduled in new AWS regions and accounts with configuration rather than code changes. * **MLOps and model serving.** Build the registration, versioning, and serving path for models so that model outputs are available to scientific applications and to downstream reporting. Integrate model output with the data layer rather than leaving it in per\-project artifacts. * **Automated benchmarking.** Build automated benchmarking and retraining for computational tools, LLM models, and agent skills used in de novo design. This includes GPU\-backed benchmarking of larger models, test\-set and dataset tracking, and a persistent record of benchmark results over time. * **Agentic AI integration.** Incorporate agentic AI into existing scientific applications: tool and skill definitions, evaluation harnesses, and the plumbing that lets agents call internal services safely. * **Data engineering.** Build reliable S3\-to\-Snowflake data pulls and automated registration of de novo design results, with monitoring and backfill behavior that does not require manual intervention. * **Performance optimization.** Take existing production pipelines and reduce their runtime and cost — profiling, GPU utilization, batching, scheduling, and container image work. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, pipelines, and CLI tooling. * Build and maintain Helm charts, container images, and deployment infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes across multiple AWS regions and accounts. * Instrument pipelines and models so that performance, cost, and benchmark results are measurable. * Work directly with scientists and engineering leads to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade tooling or pipelines. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, and container\-based deployments. * Experience developing, deploying, or optimizing machine learning pipelines in a production environment. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices. * Experience with AWS, including multi\-region or multi\-account deployments. * Experience with data warehousing and ELT patterns, Snowflake preferred. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent — as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Exposure to Rust is a plus. * Experience building LLM agents, tool definitions, or evaluation harnesses is a plus. * Willingness to learn computational biology and protein science domains. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. Optional benefits for full time employees include health, dental, and vision insurance, college loan assistance, and an employer matched retirement savings plan. Spectrix is not a placement agency.* *Spectrix is participating in the E\-Verify program of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (phone number: 888\-897\-7781, and website: www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify).* Pay: $48\.00 \- $58\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

Hydraulic design consists of hydrologic and hydraulic planning and analysis for the construction, rehabilitation or repair of structures required for conveying or draining water under, along or over Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) highway facilities. **About the Position:** The Professional Engineer I, provides engineering expertise and judgement by applying engineering theories, principles, and standards to design highway projects, prepare analyses, reports, permit clearances, and certify plans and specifications. This position ensures all design and construction work strictly complies with contract documents to deliver safe high\-performing transportation system in and near natural and human\-made water systems. This position monitors the work of professional and paraprofessional support staff assigned to projects for conformance to a scope of work, agency policy and procedural directives, and oversees and approves the work of consultants on behalf of CDOT. **Major Duties include but are not limited to:** * Perform hydrologic and hydraulic design calculations, analysis and supporting documentation for draining water through, around and over CDOT transportation infrastructure; * Document compliance with Colorado Drainage Law, review and comment on drainage designs with other agencies and consultants; * Support the preparation of floodplain compliance and water quality compliance documents to satisfy local, state, regional and federal regulations under the National Flood Insurance Program; * Review and comment on drainage designs with developers working in or near public rights\-of\-way; * Review the adequacy of drainage designs of others and prepare comments to private and public entities; * Support Project Engineers and Resident Engineers in Region 4 with technical assistance in preparing analyses and designs on road, bridge and culvert design, rehabilitation and repair projects; * Prepare estimates of hydrologic runoff volumes and hydraulic distribution of hazards and impacts, and provide written and oral recommendations of appropriate methodology based on site conditions for review; * Provide engineering judgement and expertise to investigate issues and prepare recommendations or options to resolve drainage problems encountered by roadway and bridge Maintenance forces; * Support the Resident Engineer with balancing Residency workload and schedules; * Assist in developing strategic plans for Region 4 and other Regions through the State Hydraulic Engineer; * Develop new methods and products to improve customer service and optimize state resources; * Other duties as assigned. **Work Environment:** * Your schedule will primarily be 8:00 am – 5:00 pm work hours, Monday\-Friday, but we are flexible to meet your work/life balance needs while ensuring CDOT business needs are met. * You will likely work a hybrid schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work. * Daytime travel during business hours to regular work sites and attend project site visits, meetings and trainings * Will be required to drive CDOT vehicles  includes *social security number trace, criminal records check, public court records checks, educational records, and driving records checks*. jobs.title: Computer Systems Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **This is a courtesy posting for the Iowa General Assembly. Applicants should follow instructions in "To Apply" to be considered.** Effective immediately, applications are being taken by the Legislative Services Agency for the position of Computer Systems Developer. Applicants should submit a resume and cover letter to the Director, Legislative Services Agency, State Capitol, Des Moines, Iowa 50319, online at https://www.legis.iowa.gov/careers. The Legislative Services Agency is an equal opportunity employer. Applications must be received by November 8, 2026\. The LSA is a nonpartisan, central staff agency of around 100 employees serving members and committees of the Iowa General Assembly. The LSA’s workforce spans three divisions and multiple offices where individuals contribute their unique expertise and talents to advance a shared mission of serving the Iowa General Assembly in a nonpartisan manner. The LSA offers meaningful work with great benefits. Our employees participate in the Iowa Public Employees’ Retirement System (IPERS) pension plan, the LSA is a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF), and low\-cost, high\-quality health and dental insurance is offered. The nonpartisan position will develop, create, modify, and maintain applications, databases, and webpages for the Iowa General Assembly. The position requires excellent analytical and communication skills, the ability to work as part of a team, the ability to interpret application specifications, the ability to detect and oversee the correction of problems with applications and databases, and the ability to analyze programming problems and develop satisfactory solutions. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or Information Services or a minimum four years of relevant work experience is required. Ability to handle heavy workload under extremely short deadlines and to prioritize workload is essential. This is an onsite position only. Overtime work is required with partial compensatory time provided. Beginning annual salary is $62,753\.60, or commensurate with experience. Partisan political activity and legislative issue advocacy are prohibited. **Qualifications, Skills, and Ability:** * Knowledge of computer programming techniques for one or more platforms. * Knowledge of Microsoft Windows Operating System and Microsoft SQL Server. * Knowledge of basic methods/tools used for application problem determination and resolution. * Knowledge of at least one programming language (JAVA, C\#.Net). * Ability to read and write the English language. * Ability to assume additional responsibilities and duties as assigned. * Ability to work as a team member in solving problems and improving service delivery. * Ability to provide quality work to a variety of clients and customers. * Ability to detect and oversee the correction of problems in assigned areas of responsibility. * Ability to follow oral and written instructions. * Ability to read and interpret technical manuals/publications. * Ability to logically analyze programming problems and develop satisfactory solutions. * Willingness to self\-motivate and show initiative related to workplace duties. * Willingness to learn basic knowledge of the legislative process and state government. **Duties:** * Develop, test, and maintain computer application programs for the Legislature. * Develop, test, and maintain databases for the Legislature. * Interpret program specifications and develop reports, templates, programming code, spreadsheets, etc.; test/prepare documentation to support the use of the applications. * Determine symptoms and causes related to process problems and resolve them. * Interpret program specifications and develop/modify structure diagrams, flow charts, and pseudo code to depict the logical flow of programs. * Develop code using language and tools outlined in program specifications and documents in programs. * Test programs and review results to detect and correct errors. * Display a high level of initiative, effort, attention to detail, and commitment by completing assignments efficiently with minimal supervision. * Follow policy, cooperate with supervisors, and align behavior with the goals of the organization. * Exchange information with individuals or groups effectively by listening and responding appropriately. * Overtime may be required with limited compensatory time provided. This is an onsite position only. The State of Iowa participates in E\-Verify, a federal program that helps employers confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. Within the required timeframe, new hires will be verified through the E\-Verify system to ensure authorization to work in the United States. The State of Iowa also complies with the federal Right to Work laws, which protect employees’ rights to work without being required to join a labor organization. For more information, please visit www.e\-verify.gov **Minimum Qualification Requirements** -------------------------------------- • Graduate of a college or university with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, or Information Services, or minimum of four years relevant work experience.

jobs.title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the company** --------------------- At Swift Solar, our mission is to unlock the full potential of solar energy. We believe solar can provide affordable, reliable, resilient, clean energy to virtually anyone, anywhere. But while today's solar technology is good, it's not good enough. Swift Solar's breakthrough perovskite\-silicon tandem technology will drive solar power to commanding new heights. Our tandem cells stack a perovskite layer on top of a heterojunction (HJT) silicon cell, delivering dramatically higher efficiency than traditional silicon alone. In 2026, we acquired Meyer Burger's HJT intellectual property and manufacturing assets, giving us the world's most extensive HJT patent portfolio and a clear path to gigawatt\-scale domestic production. This vertically integrated approach means we can design, manufacture, and scale next\-generation solar solutions entirely in the United States—from silicon foundations to perovskite innovations. Our technology enables applications ranging from space solar to utility\-scale power generation, creating American\-made solutions for a world facing growing energy challenges. Swift Solar is on a journey to bring revolutionary clean\-energy technology to market. We're in it for the long haul, with support from world\-class investors. Join our extraordinary team building the cutting\-edge solar technology that will power the future. **A day in the life** --------------------- You'll build AI products that assist scientists and accelerate our technical progress towards next\-generation solar solutions. Every experiment we run costs tool time, materials, and scientists' attention, so choosing what to run next is one of the biggest levers on how fast our cells improve. You'll build the AI that helps our scientists make those choices. Our systems read scientific literature and query our lab and manufacturing data, then propose experiment plans that an automated optimizer uses to execute them. You will lead development of the planning and reasoning layer, which takes a research objective as input and uses a multi\-agent system to guide our scientists and reach goals faster through the best selected experiment campaigns. Additionally, we need to measure what works and how frontier models and our own agents perform on problems our team has already worked through, so we can improve the system over time. This is also a place to experiment. When a promising new paper, model, or agent design comes out in AI for science, you can try it here on real problems instead of benchmarks someone else chose. You'll work with scientists who have spent years on perovskites, who know which questions matter and can tell you quickly whether an agent's answer makes sense. Because we develop the process and make the devices ourselves, the data, tools, and people who understand them live in the same company, so an idea can go from your screen to a measured result without waiting on anyone outside. Most of this is greenfield work, and speed matters. You'll get rough versions in front of scientists quickly, watch how they use them, and turn the ideas that hold up into production systems people rely on every day. Knowing when a prototype is ready to harden, and doing it without losing momentum, is a big part of the job. Alongside the agent work, you will: * Hold AI\-written code to a high bar. Nearly all of our code is written with AI coding tools, so critically reviewing the output and keeping the codebase documented and tested matters. * Help keep our existing data systems running, including the pipeline that brings instrument data into our database. * Review code across the team, and help hire and mentor new engineers as the team grows. * Write about what we learn for our public whitepaper series and, when the work holds up, publish it in papers and present it at conferences. **You might be a good fit if you...** ------------------------------------- * Have 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including systems that real users depend on * Have built full\-stack web applications, with a Python backend and a TypeScript/JavaScript frontend (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar) * Have built applications on frontier LLMs through their APIs, such as agents, multi\-step orchestration (e.g., LangGraph), or systems where models call tools * Can take an idea from a quick prototype to a production system that people depend on * Use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day, and can tell when what they produce is wrong * Have a CS degree or a comparable record of open\-source or portfolio work * Write documented, tested code and are comfortable working in a shared codebase with git * Can explain technical tradeoffs to scientists who aren't software engineers * Take initiative and work independently * Are coachable and comfortable when priorities change quickly * Are kind, empathetic, conscientious, and motivated to make an impact on climate change **A strong candidate might bring one or more of the following...** ------------------------------------------------------------------ * Experience with multi\-agent systems, especially ranking, review, or memory between runs * Experience building evaluations or benchmarks for LLM agents * Experience designing complex software architecture and leading projects end\-to\-end without much oversight * Familiarity with Bayesian optimization, surrogate models, fine\-tuning of open\-weights models, or reinforcement\-learning environments * Experience analyzing and plotting scientific data * An interest in science, shown through conferences, side projects, or papers (a science background is not required) * Experience getting skeptical users to adopt internal tools * Experience with SQL or database administration, AWS, Azure, or GCP, or CI/CD * Experience working at a startup **The logistics** ----------------- * Compensation: Competitive package including salary, equity, and benefits * + Expected Pay Range: $150,000 \- $220,000 per year + The actual offer, reflecting total compensation and benefits, will be determined by factors such as relevant experience, skills, and other qualifications * Ideal start date: November \- December 2026 * Job type: Full\-time * Location: San Carlos, CA (Swift Solar HQ), with some remote days possible **What you'll love about Swift** -------------------------------- * **Work with purpose**: Join our mission to unlock the full potential of solar energy and make a global impact. * **Lead with innovation**: Be part of an extraordinary team building cutting\-edge solar technology \- growth mindset; culture * **Thrive with benefits**: Have 100% of your monthly premiums for HMO / PPO group healthcare plan options and 75% of your dental and vision insurance premiums covered by us. Employees also benefit from 401(k) matching, clean commuter benefits, and meaningful equity. * **Invest in your career**: You'll grow your skills, your network, and your perspective at Swift. We'll support you in attending conferences and taking online courses, as long as you share your new insights with the team. We recognize that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often hesitate to apply if they don't meet all the criteria. If you're excited about this role and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We're eager to meet people from all backgrounds, and your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need. If you believe in our mission but this isn't the right job for you, please explore other career opportunities on our website and email us at careers@swiftsolar.com with any questions. If you have a friend who would be a perfect fit, share this link with them. Thanks! *Swift is an equal opportunity employer. We value an inclusive work environment and welcome team members of all backgrounds and perspectives.*

jobs.title: Microsoft Power Platform Developer
jobs.description: T\-Rex Solutions is seeking a Microsoft Power Platform Developer to supports both the Enterprise Intelligence and Data Solutions (EIDS) and Defense Healthcare Management System Modernization (DHMSM) programs in support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA) by building and maintaining applications, reporting, and automation that help teams manage products, portfolios, workflows, and program performance. This role is hands\-on and execution focused, with a primary emphasis on advanced Microsoft Power Apps development. The individual will design, enhance, and maintain business applications while also using Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft 365 to create integrated solutions that support day\-to\-day program operations and leadership decision\-making. The developer will support requirements across both EIDS and DHMSM and should be comfortable working across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities. The role requires someone who can understand a business need, determine the right technical approach, and independently deliver a practical and maintainable solution. The ideal candidate is an experienced Power Apps developer who also understands how reporting, automation, data, and program processes fit together in a complex enterprise environment. **Responsibilities:** **Power Apps Development** * Design, develop, enhance, and maintain advanced Microsoft Power Apps solutions * Serve as a strong hands\-on Power Apps developer capable of independently translating business requirements into working applications * Support applications used to manage products, projects, documentation, portfolio activities, and operational workflows * Manage and prioritize Power Apps development backlogs and deliver enhancements iteratively * Integrate Power Apps with Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other approved data sources * Troubleshoot application performance, usability, data, and integration issues * Design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and easy for program teams to use * Apply sound practices for application security, permissions, data access, and lifecycle management **Power Automate and Workflow Automation** * Develop Power Automate workflows to connect applications, data, and business processes * Automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort across program workflows * Build reliable and maintainable automation that supports Power Apps and other Microsoft\-based solutions * Troubleshoot workflow failures and improve existing automations as business needs evolve **Power BI Development and Reporting** * Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards using data from multiple sources * Connect Power BI to Microsoft Azure DevOps and other systems to support portfolio and execution reporting * Perform data transformation, modeling, and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability * Create clear visualizations that translate program data into useful information for leadership and delivery teams * Support reporting requirements that complement Power Apps and broader Power Platform solutions **Azure DevOps Integration** * Use Microsoft Azure DevOps as a data source and integration point for Power Platform solutions * Develop applications and reporting that support portfolio management, delivery tracking, backlog management, and performance measurement * Apply a strong technical understanding of Azure DevOps data structures, work items, and reporting capabilities * Help connect Azure DevOps information with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI where appropriate **Cross\-Program Support** * Support Power Platform needs across both EIDS and DHMSM * Work with stakeholders across multiple teams to understand, prioritize, and deliver requirements * Balance competing priorities and adjust work as program needs change * Build solutions that can be used across teams when common requirements or opportunities exist * Maintain clear visibility into work in progress, dependencies, risks, and expected delivery timelines **SAFe and Portfolio Context** * Design applications and reporting aligned with SAFe concepts, particularly portfolio management and execution tracking * Support leadership visibility into priorities, capacity, schedules, dependencies, and delivery * Apply SAFe and portfolio context when designing solutions so that applications and reporting are relevant to actual program operations **Collaboration and Enablement** * Work closely with program teams, analysts, product owners, and leadership to gather and refine requirements * Translate business needs into clear technical solutions without requiring stakeholders to define the technical approach * Demonstrate solutions, incorporate feedback, and refine applications as requirements evolve * Provide documentation and guidance to support adoption and long\-term maintenance * Help teams transition to new applications, reporting, and automated workflows **Requirements:** * 6–8 years of hands\-on experience delivering Mi cess Card (CAC) and required access to DHA systems and environments. * Strong demonstrated experience designing and developing Microsoft Power Apps, including complex applications used by business or program teams * Experience integrating Power Apps with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other data sources * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and improve Power Apps performance, usability, and maintainability * Experience building Power BI dashboards using multiple data sources * Experience integrating Microsoft Azure DevOps with Power Platform solutions for reporting, workflow, or metrics * Working knowledge of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), particularly portfolio and execution concepts * Ability to manage multiple development priorities and work across different teams or programs * Ability to translate business needs into clear and effective technical solutions * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Desired Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Project Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate * Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate * Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification **T\-Rex Overview** Established in 1999, T\-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid\-tier business providing data\-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T\-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering. T\-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T\-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T\-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits. T\-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non\-merit based factors. In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 \- $135,000\. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T\-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer. T\-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.
